title: Chinland Conflict Monitor
publisher: Chin Center for Peace and Reconciliation

incidents.detail: Detention site for prisoners of war
incidents.title: Junta bombs prisoner site in Khuanglung, 8 killed
incidents.text: At night the junta bombed a detention site in Khuanglung village holding prisoners of war captured by Chin forces in the battle for Falam. One CNDF member and seven prisoners, including police officers, were killed and three injured.

incidents.title: Landmine injures three boys in Tedim Township
incidents.text: A landmine explosion in Tedim Township injured three 12-year-old boys.

incidents.detail: On the way home on leave
incidents.title: Eight CDF-Matupi fighters arrested on leave
incidents.text: Two commanders and six fighters who had moved from CDF-Matupi Brigade 2 to Brigade 1 in November and December 2024 were arrested while returning home on leave.

incidents.title: Junta fires into Tedim town, homes damaged
incidents.text: In the morning junta Infantry Battalion 269 fired light and heavy weapons at random after seeing PDF-Zoland members moving through Tedim town; some homes were damaged.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Samee town administration office
incidents.text: The junta bombed Samee town, destroying the General Administration Office.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Arakan Army office in Matupi
incidents.text: The junta bombed the Arakan Army's military office in Matupi town, damaging nearby homes.

incidents.title: Matupi town cleared of landmines in homes area
incidents.text: CDF-Matupi (Brigade 1) said landmine clearance was complete in residential areas of Matupi town, but clearance near former military bases was not finished.

events.title: Child dies as Kaisi Clinic runs out of medicine
events.text: The Kaisi Clinic in the CDF-Matupi (Brigade 2) area ran badly short of medicine; a child from Diluangkung village, Paletwa Township, died of severe diarrhoea without treatment.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.others: Asho Chin National Federal Council (Bago Region)
events.title: Asho Chin council formed in Bago Region
events.text: The Asho Chin National Federal Council for Bago Region was formed to promote democracy, equality and self-determination.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: ZORO protests end of Free Movement Regime
events.text: ZORO in Mizoram protested India's ending of the Free Movement Regime on the India-Myanmar border as a violation of indigenous rights; it petitioned again on 14 January and burned a copy of the order on 29 January.

events.title: NUG reports 53.8 million kyats aid to Chinland in 2024
events.text: The NUG Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management said it gave 53.8 million kyats of aid to Chinland in 2024.

events.title: NUG and Chinland hire doctors for resistance areas
events.text: The NUG and the Chinland Ministry of Health began recruiting specialist doctors and other medical staff for hospitals and clinics in resistance-held areas.

events.title: Asho Chin force aids 2,178 displaced in Ngaphe
events.text: The Asho Chin Defense Force and humanitarian groups gave over 26 million kyats of aid to 2,178 displaced people from 13 villages in Ngaphe Township.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Cholera kills two infants in Paletwa
events.text: A cholera outbreak in Paletwa Township since December killed two one-year-old children in early January; Chin health workers had fled after the Arakan Army took the township.

events.title: CDF-Kanpetlet bans picking flowers in national park
events.text: CDF-Kanpetlet (Battalion 3) banned visitors from picking wildflowers such as rhododendrons, cherry blossoms and orchids in the Khonumthung (Natma Taung) National Park.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chinland Council urges talks among southern forces
events.text: The Chinland Council Chairman urged CDF-Mindat, the Maraland Defense Force and CDF-Kanpetlet to settle their disputes through negotiation, stressing unity among Chin resistance groups.

events.title: Tedim council plans operation to take Tedim town
events.text: The Tedim Township Council and People's Defense Army announced plans for an operation to take Tedim town and told residents to prepare.

events.title: Five arrested with AK-47s in Mizoram
events.text: Mizoram police and intelligence agencies arrested five Myanmar nationals in Saithah village with six AK-47 rifles, ammunition and magazines.

events.title: Kanpetlet residents accuse AA and CDF-Kanpetlet of abuses
events.text: Residents of Kanpetlet Township said the Arakan Army and CDF-Kanpetlet continued to commit abuses after the junta withdrew.

events.title: NUG gives $100,000 each to Chinland Council and ICNCC
events.text: The NUG gave 100,000 US dollars each to the Chinland Council and the ICNCC from its revolutionary fundraising.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Indian army chief announces border fencing
events.text: India's army chief announced stronger surveillance and fencing on the India-Myanmar border; Arunachal Pradesh and Manipur supported it, Nagaland and Mizoram opposed it.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Samee clinic under AA short of doctors and medicine
events.text: The main clinic in Samee town, under Arakan Army control, lacked doctors, medicine and supplies, making it hard for residents to get care.

events.title: Hakha Central Council bans illegal timber trade
events.text: The Hakha Central Council banned transporting and selling illegally cut timber not registered with its forestry department.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: MZP meets Mizoram Chief Minister on FMR
events.text: The Mizo Zirlai Pawl met Mizoram's Chief Minister about the impact of ending the Free Movement Regime.

events.title: Paletwa Council: 100 villages set up administration
events.text: The Paletwa Council said 100 of the 388 villages in Paletwa Township had set up their own local administration.

events.others: Chin detainees in an Assam prison
events.title: 32 Chin detainees on hunger strike in Assam
events.text: Thirty-two Chin detainees in a prison in Assam, India, went on hunger strike because they had not been released after finishing their sentences.

events.title: Stink bean prices collapse in northern Chinland
events.text: Farmers in northern Chinland growing stink beans (Parkia speciosa) for India saw prices fall from 150 kyats a pod last year to just over 50 kyats.

events.title: Chin Health Organization serves Paletwa villages
events.text: The Chin Health Organization was providing health services in Paletwa Council villages, working with local people's administration committees.

events.title: CNDF: over 100 junta troops killed in Falam battle
events.text: The CNDF said the junta had lost over 100 soldiers and police in three months of fighting for Falam, and that it would keep trying to take the remaining Infantry Battalion 268 positions.

incidents.title: Two men die after ZRA-EC beating in Ngalhbual
incidents.text: Two men from Ngalhbual village were arrested and beaten by ZRA-EC troops stationed in the village under a curfew. One died on 6 February and the other on 8 February.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Matupi town
incidents.text: The junta carried out an aerial bombing of Matupi town. The extent of the damage was not known.

incidents.title: Three arrested with opium near Zothei, Mizoram
incidents.text: Two Myanmar men and one Myanmar woman were arrested at the border near Zothei village, Champhai District, with 945 grams of opium.

incidents.detail: Outpost of the People's Defense Army-Tedim
incidents.title: ZRA-EC attacks PDA outpost in Tedim
incidents.text: The Zomi Revolutionary Army (Eastern Command) launched an offensive against an outpost controlled by the People's Defense Army-Tedim, a member of the Chinland Council. Casualties not reported.

incidents.detail: General Administration Department office and police station
incidents.title: Junta bombs Webula offices and police station
incidents.text: An aerial bombing at about 10:30 AM caused substantial damage to the General Administration Department office and the police station in Webula town.

incidents.title: Two 500-pound bombs hit Mindat town
incidents.text: Two 500-pound bombs were dropped on Sanpiah ward, Mindat town, at about 1:00 AM. Damage and casualties not reported.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Halta injures five, two children
incidents.text: An airstrike on Halta village at about 1:00 PM injured five civilians, including two children under ten, and destroyed three houses.

incidents.title: Bombing destroys church in Pyinwa village
incidents.text: A bombing of Pyinwa village at about 9:00 PM destroyed a Presbyterian church and a community hall.

events.title: Hakha schools taught 22,487 students since 2021
events.text: The Education Department of the Hakha Central Council said its schools had provided basic education to 22,487 students in Hakha Township between 2021 and 2024.

events.detail: Refugees from Sin Oe Wa village, Paletwa Township
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: AA pressures Paletwa refugees in Mizoram to return
events.text: Refugees from Sin-Oo-wah village, Paletwa Township, sheltering in Siaha District, Mizoram, reported growing pressure from an Arakan Army-appointed administrator to return home.

events.title: 8,147 students in Paletwa community schools
events.text: 8,147 students were studying in 119 interim community-based schools in Paletwa Township, with 2024-2025 final exams scheduled for February, according to the Paletwa Township Council.

events.detail: Mindat, Kanpetlet, Matupi and Paletwa Townships
events.title: Diarrhoea outbreak hits 418 in southern townships
events.text: An outbreak of diarrhea and suspected cholera had affected 418 people in Mindat, Kanpetlet, Matupi and Paletwa Townships since late December 2024, with four deaths including three children under one year old.

events.title: Chinland runs 660 schools for 56,000 students
events.text: At the Chinland Council's first-anniversary press conference, the Minister of Education said about 660 schools had been set up for the 2024-2025 academic year, serving more than 56,000 students.

events.others: Malaysia's special envoy for Myanmar (ASEAN chair 2025); KNU; KNPP
events.title: ASEAN envoy meets NUG and K3C in Bangkok
events.text: Malaysia's special envoy for Myanmar, representing the 2025 ASEAN chair, held meetings in Bangkok with the NUG, the K3C coalition (KNU, KNPP and CNF) and other stakeholders.

events.title: Tedim council repairs roads with church funds
events.text: The Tedim Township Council completed road repairs in parts of Tedim Township, financed by local religious organizations.

events.title: Mindat charges fee for residents to return
events.text: The Mindat Township People's Administration allowed residents to return to Mindat town only if they showed past contributions to the resistance or paid 500,000 MMK to the town fund. Many residents objected.

events.title: Hualngoram to be governed by traditional system
events.text: The Hualngoram People's Organization announced that the Hualngoram region would be governed according to its traditional system from the pre-colonial and British colonial periods.

events.detail: Highways in the Hualngoram region and Thantlang Township
events.title: Chinland Government repairs Hualngoram highways
events.text: The Chinland Government and local administrations were jointly repairing major highways in the Hualngoram region and Thantlang Township.

events.title: Child dies without medicine in rural Paletwa
events.text: A six-year-old child in rural Paletwa Township died for lack of medical treatment amid shortages of essential medicines.

events.title: CNF and allies start drafting federal transition rules
events.text: The CNF and nine other ethnic resistance organizations began drafting the Articles of Federal Transitional Arrangements (AFTA) for the transition to a federal system.

events.detail: Eight villages on the Kalay-Gangaw road, southern Kalay Township, Sagaing Region
events.title: 4,000 flee airstrikes in southern Kalay
events.text: Junta airstrikes forced about 4,000 residents of eight villages along the Kalay-Gangaw road in southern Kalay Township, Sagaing Region, to flee. About 100 displaced people had diarrhea amid a shortage of medical supplies.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Avocado export prices to Mizoram rise
events.text: Avocado export prices from Chinland to Mizoram rose from 150,000 MMK to over 200,000 MMK per sack, according to local producers.

events.title: Chinland Council urges talks in Lautu-Mara dispute
events.text: The Chinland Council distanced itself from the territorial dispute between the Chin Defense Force-Lautu and the Mara Defense Force and urged both to settle it through peaceful negotiation.

events.others: Mindat Township IDP Camp Management Committee
events.title: Diarrhoea in 13 Mindat villages, three deaths
events.text: The Mindat Township IDP Camp Management Committee reported 226 cases of diarrhea across 13 villages in Mindat Township, with three deaths.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: India to stop illegal trade at Border Gate No. 2
events.text: The Government of India was preparing to suspend illegal trade at Border Trade Gate No. 2 between Champhai District, Mizoram, and Rihkhawdar town, according to the Times of India.

events.title: CDF-Mindat orders civilians to hand in weapons
events.text: The CDF-Mindat ordered civilians in Mindat Township holding firearms, including M79 launchers and ammunition, to surrender them by 15 March.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chinland Council and ICNCC agree to form Chin National Council
events.text: After peace talks in Aizawl facilitated by a mediation group led by the Chief Minister of Mizoram, the Chinland Council and the Interim Chin National Consultative Council agreed to form a new council named the Chin National Council, with a Chin National Constitution Drafting Committee.

events.detail: Paletwa public hospital and government offices
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA moves hospital equipment out of Paletwa
events.text: The Arakan Army was moving medical equipment and administrative resources from Paletwa public hospital and government offices to Rakhine State by military boat, raising concern about public services in the area.

events.others: Mizoram Rajya Sabha MP K. Vanlalvena
events.title: Mizoram MP visits CNF headquarters
events.text: Rajya Sabha MP K. Vanlalvena from Mizoram visited the CNF headquarters and met Chinland Council leaders.

incidents.actors: ZRA-EC vs CNA and People's Defense Army-Tedim
incidents.title: ZRA-EC attacks CNA and PDA near Tunzan
incidents.text: The Zomi Revolutionary Army (Eastern Command), which works with the junta, launched a surprise attack on the Chin National Army and the People's Defense Army-Tedim near Tunzan village. Casualties not reported.

incidents.title: Mindat clears over 2,000 junta landmines
incidents.text: The Mindat Township Administration reported clearing more than 2,000 landmines planted by junta forces while repairing roads and drinking water systems.

incidents.title: CDF-CDM Siyin acts against opium
incidents.text: CDF-CDM Siyin, a Chinland Council member, announced coordinated action against opium cultivation, production and trade in areas it controls.

incidents.title: Kanpetlet residents stay away over landmines
incidents.text: Although the junta had been absent for nearly three months, residents had not returned to Kanpetlet town because landmine clearance was still under way and the Arakan Army and CDF-Kanpetlet were present.

incidents.detail: Zamual village, two miles from Falam town on the Falam-Kalay highway (several villages share the name)
incidents.title: Airstrike destroys four houses in Zamual
incidents.text: A junta airstrike at about 3:00 PM on Zamual village, two miles from Falam town on the Falam-Kalay highway, destroyed four houses.

incidents.title: Junta artillery injures two in Tedim Township
incidents.text: Junta artillery fired into Tedim Township at about 5:00 PM injured two civilians and damaged two houses.

incidents.title: Airstrike destroys four houses in Tlangzar
incidents.text: A junta airstrike at about 1:00 AM on Tlangzar village on the Falam-Hakha highway destroyed four houses.

incidents.title: Chin forces take most of IB 268 in Falam
incidents.text: The Chin resistance coalition seized most strategic positions of Infantry Battalion 268 in Falam. The battalion commander, a lieutenant colonel, was reported killed in action on 17 March.

incidents.actors: Lunglei District Special Branch and BSF
incidents.title: Six arrested with heroin in Lunglei
incidents.text: Four people from Myanmar and two Mizos were arrested in Lunglei with heroin worth about 800,000 Indian rupees. Weight not reported. Arrests counted: Myanmar nationals only.

incidents.actors: Anti-Narcotics Task Force, Saiha Youth Group and Bualpui NG YLA
incidents.title: 5.5 kg of heroin seized in Lawngtlai District
incidents.text: A Myanmar national was arrested in Bualpui NG village, Lawngtlai District, with 5.5 kg of heroin valued at 1.5 million Indian rupees.

events.title: CNF denies role in forming CDF-Ngawnngam
events.text: The CNF rejected the Ngawn Union Council's claim that the CNA financed or planned the formation of CDF-Ngawnngam, saying it does not interfere in local defence forces in areas free of junta control.

events.title: CDF-Thantlang runs most of Thantlang Township
events.text: CDF-Thantlang Council said about 99% of Thantlang Township, except the town, ran under its local governance: schools up to Grade 12, health care for about 17,000 patients and 24 civil cases decided.

events.title: CDF-Thantlang bans hunting until June
events.text: CDF-Thantlang banned hunting of wild animals, including muntjac and deer, in its areas from March to June 2025.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA bars Paletwa health workers without permission
events.text: In Paletwa Township, nurses and health workers were barred from treating patients or selling medicines without Arakan Army permission.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.others: Young Chin politicians allied with the junta (proposed Chinland New Congress party)
issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Pro-junta Chin party applies to register
events.text: A group of young Chin politicians allied with the junta applied to the Election Commission to register a new party, the Chinland New Congress.

events.title: CDF-Thantlang issues fire safety rules
events.text: CDF-Thantlang issued fire prevention measures, asking residents to keep fire safety tools ready from 6 March to 3 May.

events.title: Only 471 sit junta university exams in Hakha and Tedim
events.text: Only 471 students registered in Hakha and Tedim for the junta's 2024-2025 university entrance exams.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.detail: Daai region (Paletwa, Matupi, Kanpetlet and Mindat Townships)
events.title: Daai Regional Council holds education workshop
events.text: The Daai Regional Council held a two-day education workshop with 120 representatives on interim education policy, plans for higher education and a unified regional curriculum.

events.title: Paletwa Council assembly approves policies
events.text: The Interim Khumi Affairs Consultative Council/Paletwa Council held its third assembly with 360 representatives and approved governance, defence and financial policies and operating guidelines.

events.title: Mindat repairs roads and water systems
events.text: The Mindat Township Administration reported repairing roads and drinking water systems in the township.

events.title: Chinland Council holds political roadmap workshop
events.text: The Chinland Council held a political roadmap workshop in Chinlung town with 60 representatives of Chinland Council entities.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram CM sees some benefit in ending FMR
events.text: The Chief Minister of Mizoram acknowledged some benefits from ending the Free Movement Regime during the Mizoram Legislative Assembly session.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Aizawl court: refugees not eligible for Indian IDs
events.text: The Aizawl District Court notified that Myanmar refugees in Mizoram are not eligible for Indian documents such as voter ID, Aadhaar, birth, tribal or residential certificates.

events.title: Clashes keep displacing civilians in southern Kalay
events.text: Clashes since 13 February and junta airstrikes in southern Kalay Township continued to displace civilians, who faced severe shortages of drinking water and food.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland leaders explain new local laws in Zophei, Mara, Lautu
events.text: Leaders of the Chinland Council, Parliament and Government visited the Zophei, Mara and Lautu regions from 14 to 18 March to explain the newly enacted Chinland Local Administration Laws.

events.title: Tedim coffee price rises
events.text: The price of coffee in Tedim Township rose from 10,000 MMK per viss in 2024 to 15,000 MMK in 2025, according to local farmers.

events.others: Farkawn Village Council and civil society organizations
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Farkawn to close Chin refugee market stalls
events.text: The Village Council and civil society groups of Farkawn village, Champhai District, decided to close all market stalls run by Chin refugees by 31 May 2025.

events.others: Zo Reunification Organization (ZORO); India's Home Minister
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: ZORO asks Amit Shah to restore FMR
events.text: The Zo Reunification Organization met India's Home Minister Amit Shah and urged him to reinstate the Free Movement Regime on the India-Myanmar border.

events.title: CNF Central Committee meets on strategy
events.text: The CNF held the third Central Committee meeting of its 8th party congress on military, political and strategic policy, and reaffirmed its commitment to unifying Chin resistance groups.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram to collect biometrics of 40,000 refugees
events.text: Mizoram's Home Minister told the Legislative Assembly the state was working with the central government to collect biometric data of more than 40,000 refugees, including 33,505 Myanmar nationals.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland leaders consult Matupi and Zotung on new laws
events.text: Chinland Council leaders visited the Matupi and Zotung regions from 17 to 21 March to consult communities on the new Chinland Local Administration Laws.

events.title: Hakha prices rise as supplies cut
events.text: Commodity prices in Hakha rose sharply because of supply disruptions from Mandalay, causing hardship for residents.

events.title: Children vaccinated in 65 Paletwa villages
events.text: Health workers from the Chin Health Organization and the local administration vaccinated children under five in 65 villages of Paletwa Township (polio, rotavirus, measles-mumps-rubella, pentavalent and others).

events.title: Free anthrax vaccination for livestock in Mindat
events.text: Free anthrax vaccination for cattle, buffalo and other livestock began in Mindat Township, according to the Township Administration.

events.title: CNF frees 72 prisoners on Chin Revolution Day
events.text: On the 37th Chin Revolution Day the CNF announced the release of 72 prisoners, reported the capture of several junta bases in early 2025, and reaffirmed its aim of abolishing the 2008 Constitution and building a federal union.

events.title: CDF-Thantlang seizes assets of junta supporter
events.text: CDF-Thantlang announced the confiscation of all assets in and around Thantlang town of a resident it accused of supporting the junta and aiding violent acts.

events.title: CDF-CDM Siyin bans night vehicle travel
events.text: CDF-CDM Siyin banned vehicle movement in its area between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM without prior notice, for security reasons.

events.title: 3,000 Asho Chin villagers displaced in Magway
events.text: About 3,000 residents of more than ten Asho Chin villages in the Ann-Padan area of Magway Region were displaced by junta airstrikes and ground offensives and needed food.

events.title: CDF-Zotung restricts weapons in Zotung region
events.text: CDF-Zotung urged residents not to carry weapons and required armed groups passing through the Zotung region to notify it in advance with identification.

events.title: CNF rejects junta peace talks
events.text: The CNF spokesperson dismissed the junta's NSPNC peace talks held in Naypyitaw on 24-26 March as deceptive and illegitimate because key stakeholders were excluded.

events.detail: Thanchaung-Kophe Gyi village, Daai Regional Council Area 2
events.title: Mother loses baby without midwife in Paletwa
events.text: A mother lost her baby in childbirth with no midwife or medical supplies in Thanchaung-Kophe Gyi village, Paletwa Township; she was taken to hospital in Mrauk U, Rakhine State.

events.detail: Response to the 28 March Sagaing earthquake
events.title: Chinland Council pledges 10 billion kyats for quake victims
events.text: After the 7.7-magnitude earthquake near Sagaing on 28 March, the Chinland Council pledged 10 billion kyats, offered a free hospital and appealed for aid; the Chinland Government pledged medical supplies, food and reconstruction support.

events.title: CNF urges junta to stop strikes in quake areas
events.text: The CNF urged the junta to stop airstrikes and military operations in earthquake-affected areas and to allow humanitarian access without political interference.

events.detail: Supply routes from Magway Region to Mindat and Matupi
events.title: Junta cuts supply lines to southern Chinland
events.text: The junta's Artillery Battalion 368 cut supply lines between southern Chinland and Magway Region, mainly affecting Mindat and Matupi Townships, and set up a new post near Pansan village, Kyaukhtu Township.

events.title: Wildfire burns houses of displaced people
events.text: A spreading wildfire destroyed the houses of two displaced civilians at about 7:00 PM, according to local sources.

incidents.title: Junta bombing destroys three homes in Mindat
incidents.text: A junta aerial bombardment of Mindat town destroyed three civilian homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages 15 buildings in Kanpetlet town
incidents.text: An afternoon junta airstrike on Kanpetlet town damaged 15 buildings, including five civilian homes, government offices, staff housing and a public hall.

incidents.actors: Chinland Government forces and allies vs ZRA-EC
incidents.title: Fighting around Tonzang against ZRA-EC offensive
incidents.text: Chinland Government forces and allies fought defensive battles in and around Tonzang from 2 to 4 April against an offensive by the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command). CNF/CNA Brigade 4 and CDF-Hualngoram announced counter-attacks.

incidents.title: Jets drop two bombs on Mindat town
incidents.text: Junta fighter jets dropped two 500-pound bombs on Mindat town at about 1:30 PM, destroying five public buildings and damaging five civilian homes.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC burns 75 houses in Nakzang
incidents.text: ZRA (Eastern Command) forces burned down 75 houses in Nakzang village, forcing more than 410 civilians to flee to Tonzang town.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC burns 34 houses in Buangmual
incidents.text: ZRA (Eastern Command) forces burned down 34 houses in Buangmual village while retreating from Chinland Government counter-attacks.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Phui kills six civilians
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Phui village at about 9:00 PM killed six civilians, including an infant and an Assemblies of God missionary, wounded nine and destroyed more than ten houses.

incidents.actors: Chin Brotherhood and allies vs junta (IB 268)
incidents.title: Chin Brotherhood captures IB 268, Falam Township free of junta
incidents.text: The Chin Brotherhood announced the complete capture of the Infantry Battalion 268 camp in Falam with allied forces, leaving Falam Township free of junta presence and seizing missiles, weapons, ammunition and cash.

incidents.title: Airstrike in Kanpetlet town kills one civilian
incidents.text: An airstrike near the Na-Ta-La school junction in Kanpetlet town at about 10:00 AM killed one civilian.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Saizang kills six civilians
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Saizang village at about midnight killed six civilians and injured one.

incidents.actors: Young Lai Association, Mizoram Police and Assam Rifles
incidents.title: Man arrested in Lungrang by YLA and Mizoram police
incidents.text: A joint team of the Young Lai Association, Mizoram Police and Assam Rifles arrested a Myanmar national in Lungrang village, Hakha Township, near Siacangkawn village in Lawngtlai District, with 180,000 methamphetamine pills.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages Mindat Baptist Church
incidents.text: A junta airstrike at about 4:30 PM damaged Mindat Baptist Church (formerly Myoma Baptist Church) in Mindat town.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages seven homes in Mindat
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes with two 250-pound bombs at about 5:20 PM damaged seven civilian homes in Mindat town.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Matupi injures five, including a pastor
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes on Matupi town and nearby areas at about 2:00 PM injured five civilians, including a pastor, and destroyed several homes.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC attacks Tonzang town on Easter Sunday
incidents.text: On Easter Sunday at about 5:00 AM the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) attacked Tonzang town, held by CDF-Tonzang, a Chinland Council member.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha arrests two junta police for extortion
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha arrested two junta police officers who had threatened residents and extorted money at gunpoint in Hakha.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Webula injures six, damages church
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes on Webula town at about 8:30 PM injured six civilians and damaged 15 buildings, including a church.

events.title: Paletwa displaced in Tuidan face food shortage
events.text: Over 100 of 270 displaced households from Paletwa Township relocated to Tuidan village, Lawngtlai District, faced severe food shortages and needed emergency help.

events.title: Charcoal prices rise in Hakha with power cuts
events.text: Charcoal prices in Hakha rose from 25,000 to 40,000 MMK per bag because of prolonged power cuts.

events.title: Indian quake aid arrives in Rihkhawdar
events.text: Indian government aid for earthquake victims arrived in Rihkhawdar, controlled by CDF-Hualngoram, for storage and distribution to affected areas.

events.title: 410 flee Nakzang to Tonzang after houses burned
events.text: More than 410 civilians from Nakzang village fled to Tonzang town after ZRA (Eastern Command) forces burned 75 houses.

events.others: Chanmary Local Council; Young Mizo Association
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Aizawl ward limits renting to displaced people
events.text: The local council and Young Mizo Association in Chanmary ward, Aizawl, announced that displaced people from Myanmar may rent houses only with their consent and permission.

events.title: CNF rejects ZPCC statement on Nakzang burning
events.text: The CNF rejected a Zomi Political Coordination Committee statement, saying the ZRA was trying to cover up its burning of Nakzang village and must take responsibility.

events.others: Matupi Township Health Department; Chin Health Organization
events.title: Matupi vaccinates children and pregnant women
events.text: The Matupi Township Health Department completed the first phase of vaccination for 40 children under two and 10 pregnant women, with support from the Chin Health Organization and donors.

events.title: MZP urges Mizoram law to protect displaced people
events.text: The Mizo Zirlai Pawl urged the Mizoram government to enact laws to support and protect displaced people.

events.title: Chinland Council congratulates Chin Brotherhood on Falam
events.text: The Chinland Council and the CNF congratulated the Chin Brotherhood and allies on capturing Falam town and pledged to keep fighting for a federal union and self-determination.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Chin refugees in Delhi ask UNHCR for cards
events.text: The Chin Refugee Committee-New Delhi asked UNHCR's protection unit to issue UN cards because of security concerns for displaced people from Myanmar in New Delhi.

events.title: Mara council bans hunting and electric fishing
events.text: The Mara Territorial Council/Mara Defense Force banned hunting, bird catching, killing wildlife, electric fishing and fishing with explosives in Mara territory from 16 April to the end of June.

events.title: CDF-Hakha calls youth to join operation on Hakha
events.text: CDF-Hakha called on all Chin youth to join the operation to capture Hakha, the capital of Chin State.

events.title: Lunglei police bar displaced people from vehicles
events.text: The Lunglei District Superintendent of Police told displaced people at Nahasiha camp that they may not drive or own vehicles, on pain of legal action.

events.title: CDF-CDM Siyin arrests two for misusing its name
events.text: CDF-CDM Siyin arrested two men who had collected money from civilians in Tedim town by misusing the group's name.

events.title: CNF holds gender policy workshop
events.text: The CNF Working Group for Policy Studies held a two-day workshop on developing a gender policy in Chinlung, with about 50 participants including women party members and women soldiers.

incidents.title: Landmine injures two in Nga-lai village
incidents.text: A landmine explosion in Nga-lai village injured two civilians.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha arrests two junta police spies
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha arrested two junta-affiliated police officers who were posing as civilians to gather information on resistance forces.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Mindat kills civilians
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Mindat town killed civilians (number not reported) and damaged government buildings and homes.

incidents.title: Junta strikes damage 15 homes in Mindat
incidents.text: Two junta strikes on Mindat town at about 10:30 PM damaged 15 civilian homes and public buildings, according to the Township Public Administration. Counted as one attack (same place, same time).

incidents.title: Junta soldier captured, two defect in Hakha
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha captured a junta soldier on 15 May; another soldier and a police officer defected on 15 and 17 May.

incidents.detail: Zong Taung village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Airstrike on Zong Taung kills two, injures 11
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Zong Taung village killed a student and a woman, injured 11 civilians and damaged a school and more than 40 homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Tonzang town injures one
incidents.text: A junta airstrike dropped two bombs on Tonzang town, injuring one civilian and destroying a government office and the Planning Department building.

incidents.title: HPO arrests CNO education official with heroin
incidents.text: HPO/CDF-Hualngoram arrested a school founder and Chin National Organization education board member in Ward 2, Rihkhawdar, with 427 small boxes of heroin; 6,000 amphetamine tablets, rupees and kyats from drug sales were also found. The Chin National Organization denied involvement.

incidents.detail: Near a captured former junta base, Shinletwa village
incidents.title: Landmine near old base in Shinletwa kills one
incidents.text: A landmine explosion near a captured former junta base in Shinletwa village at about 3:00 PM killed one person and injured another (civilian or combatant not stated).

incidents.detail: Advance from Kalay towards northern Chinland
incidents.actors: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces resist 800 junta troops from Kalay
incidents.text: The Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood jointly launched a defensive operation against about 800 junta troops advancing from the base in Kalay towards northern Chinland, according to the CNF/CNA spokesperson.

events.title: Mindat bans hornbill hunting in breeding season
events.text: The Mindat Township Public Administration banned hunting and capturing rare birds, including hornbills, during the May-June breeding season.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: MZP opposes India's border fence
events.text: The Mizo Zirlai Pawl opposed the Indian government's border fencing plan, saying it would block the reunification of Chin (Zo) peoples.

events.title: Paletwa displaced in Siaha ill with malaria
events.text: About 40 displaced people from Paletwa Township at Kheikhong village, Siaha District, were reported ill with diarrhea and malaria.

events.title: Khumi and Paletwa councils hold Sami election
events.text: The Interim Khumi Affairs Consultative Council and Paletwa Council held a public administration election and public meeting with over 70 representatives in the Sami region.

events.title: Chin Health Organization offers nursing scholarships
events.text: The Chin Health Organization announced that five students would be selected for scholarships to study nursing and laboratory science at an Indian university.

events.others: Young Mizo Association and three other civil society groups
events.title: Aizawl ward bars new displaced arrivals
events.text: Four civil society groups including the Young Mizo Association restricted the entry of new displaced people into Edenthar ward, Aizawl, except those already settled there.

events.title: Chinland graduates medical interns in Chinlung
events.text: The Chinland Council and Government held a completion ceremony on 6 May in Chinlung for medical interns and public health trainees trained under the Ministry of Sports and Health.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: India and Mizoram plan biometrics of refugees
events.text: India's central government and Mizoram's Home Department met online to discuss biometric data collection of displaced people from Myanmar in Mizoram, expected to start soon.

events.title: CDF-Thado and ZRA-EC exchange prisoners
events.text: CDF-Thado and the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) exchanged prisoners: four CDF-Thado members and one ZRA soldier were released.

events.detail: Daai areas of Paletwa, Matupi, Kanpetlet and Mindat Townships
events.title: Daai Regional Council sets up local administration
events.text: The Daai Regional Council announced that local governance and public administration had been set up in Daai areas of Paletwa, Matupi, Kanpetlet and Mindat Townships.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: 525 Paletwa refugees in Kheikhong ill, no medicine
events.text: In Kheikhong village, Siaha District, 525 refugees from Paletwa Township (139 households) were suffering from diarrhea and malaria, with cases rising for lack of medicine.

events.title: HPO says Hualngoram no longer under any junta town
events.text: The Hualngoram People's Organization said the Hualngoram area, set up under the Chinland Constitution 2023, is under local administration and no longer part of any junta-designated township.

events.title: Junta blocks roads out of Hakha
events.text: The junta in Hakha blocked the Hakha-Falam and Hakha-Gangaw roads to restrict civilian movement, as defections to CDF-Hakha increased.

events.title: Lunglei council to hold refugees' Myanmar IDs
events.text: The Electric Veng Local Council in Lunglei announced plans to temporarily hold the Myanmar ID cards of Chin displaced people living in its area.

events.type: Road or trade route closed or reopened
events.title: Lunglei-Paletwa route closed four days
events.text: The route between Lunglei District and Paletwa, used mainly to carry goods to Rakhine State, was closed on 16 May and reopened four days later.

events.detail: Twelve villages in Tat Chaung and Lan Dan village tracts
events.title: Fever outbreak in 12 Paletwa villages, deaths
events.text: Twelve villages in the Tat Chaung and Landon village tracts, Paletwa Township, had a fever outbreak since March, with deaths reported for lack of medicine and health workers.

events.detail: Magway, Bago, Naypyitaw, Ayeyarwady, Yangon and Rakhine
events.title: Asho Chin council plans self-determination
events.text: The Asho Chin National Federal Council announced plans for self-determination and nation-building for Asho Chin people in 39 townships across six regions and states.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Matupi Brigades 1 and 2 sign eight agreements
events.text: A meeting of the Peace Committee, CDF-Matupi Brigade 1 and Brigade 2 signed eight agreements, including not using arms to settle internal conflicts, free civilian movement and a new peacekeeping committee.

events.title: Chinland Defence Ministry meets CNA and CDFs
events.text: The Chinland Government's Ministry of Defence held a coordination meeting in Chinlung on training, formation and policy between the Chin National Army and local Chinland Defense Forces.

events.detail: Hmulpi, Htay Zang, Hein Zing and Bum Sam villages on the Kalay-Thaingin road
events.title: 1,300 sheltering off Kalay-Thaingin road need aid
events.text: More than 1,300 people from four villages along the Kalay-Thaingin road had been sheltering in nearby villages and farms for about two weeks and needed food, shelter and medicine.

incidents.title: Airstrike destroys government building in Mindat
incidents.text: A junta airstrike dropped two bombs on Mindat town at about 6:00 PM, destroying a government building, according to the Township Public Administration.

incidents.title: CDF-Tonzang seizes ZRA-EC base
incidents.text: CDF-Tonzang seized a base of the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command); two ZRA soldiers were killed and two drones, four weapons, a car and seven motorbikes were seized.

incidents.actors: Hualngoram Police and Hualngoram Reserve Force
incidents.title: Hualngoram police seize 270,000 tablets
incidents.text: During a security operation in Bethel ward, Rihkhawdar, Hualngoram Police and the Hualngoram Reserve Force arrested a man from Paltel village with about 270,000 stimulant tablets worth 56 million rupees.

incidents.actors: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces resist junta column on Kalay-Thaingin road
incidents.text: A junta column moving from Kalay towards northern Chin State on the Kalay-Thaingin road was resisted by Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood forces; ammunition was seized, some soldiers were arrested and some defected.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Lunghlaw, no damage
incidents.text: The junta bombed Lunghlaw village at about 9:00 PM. No damage was reported.

incidents.title: YLA arrests and expels drug trader in Thingkah
incidents.text: A man from Kalay Township involved in drug trading and use was arrested by the Central Young Lai Association in Thingkah village, Lawngtlai District, and expelled to Myanmar.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Khaikam elephant camp kills boy
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on the Khaikam elephant camp at about 4:00 PM killed a 16-year-old boy and injured a woman.

incidents.detail: Laithan hill (Thangmaul), a public recreation site on the Kalay-Tedim road
incidents.title: Junta bombs Laithan hill, one injured
incidents.text: The junta bombed Laithan hill, a public recreation site on the Kalay-Tedim road, at about 5:00 PM, injuring one local civilian.

incidents.title: Woman arrested with heroin on Champhai highway
incidents.text: Police on the Champhai-Aizawl highway arrested a woman from Tahan ward, Kalay, with 44 grams of heroin.

incidents.title: Man arrested with heroin in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Indian authorities arrested a man from Tahan ward, Kalay, in Zokhawthar village with 142 grams of heroin worth over 400,000 rupees.

incidents.detail: Three junta outposts at Hmualpi, Siyin area
incidents.actors: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces capture three outposts at Hmualpi
incidents.text: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood forces attacked three junta outposts at Hmualpi village from 26 June and captured them by 28 June; at least 15 junta soldiers died, according to local sources.

incidents.title: Junta destroys Tedim-Rih trade road
incidents.text: The junta dug up and destroyed part of the cross-border trade road between Tedim and Rih, making travel to the border difficult.

incidents.title: 20,000 stimulant tablets seized in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Mizoram Police and Assam Rifles arrested a Myanmar national in Zokhawthar with over 20,000 stimulant tablets worth 667,000 rupees, according to India Today. Reported in the July briefing.

events.title: Fever and flu in CDF-Asho areas of Magway
events.text: Since April more than 100 residents in CDF-Asho-controlled areas of Magway Region had fever and seasonal flu, and urgent medical supplies were needed.

events.others: Zomi Federal Union Township Education Board
events.title: PDF-Zoland education board warns junta supporters
events.text: The Township Education Board of the Zomi Federal Union/PDF-Zoland warned it would act against officials supporting the junta, spreading hate speech or obstructing public education in Tedim Township.

events.title: House fire kills woman in Hakha
events.text: A house fire in Zaythit ward, Hakha, at about 11:30 PM killed a 35-year-old woman. The cause was unknown.

events.title: Mindat plants trees on World Environment Day
events.text: The Mindat Township People's Administration said it was working to protect rare plants, wildlife and water resources, and planted trees at the town entrance for World Environment Day.

events.detail: Gangaw-Yezwa section of the Union Highway
events.title: Chinland and Zotung repair Gangaw-Yezwa road
events.text: The Chinland Government and the Zotung Federal Council were repairing rain damage on the Gangaw-Yezwa section of the Union Highway linking Magway Region and Chinland.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Lautu council approves municipal law
events.text: The Lautu People Affairs Council held its second regular meeting with 73 representatives and approved the 2025 Regional Municipal Law.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram tightens Inner Line Permit
events.text: At the first Mizoram State Security Council meeting, Chief Minister Lalduhoma ordered stricter enforcement of the Inner Line Permit system amid concern about armed groups and drug trafficking from Myanmar.

events.title: Kalay-Tedim road blocked a month, food short
events.text: A junta offensive in northern Chinland had blocked the Kalay-Tedim road for nearly a month, cutting off goods and causing food shortages in Tedim Township.

events.title: CNF urges India to review Myanmar policy
events.text: CNF Vice Chairman Dr. Sui Khar told The Diplomat that junta airstrikes had worsened the humanitarian crisis and urged India to review its neutral policy on Myanmar.

events.others: Elected MPs from the 2020 election; local administrations
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chinland Council discusses amending constitution for CNC
events.text: The Chinland Council leadership committee discussed amending the 2023 Chinland Constitution, focused on establishing the Chin National Council; CNF representation was reduced from 27 to 15 members.

events.title: HPO bans heavy trucks in rainy season
events.text: The HPO Public Works Department banned large cargo trucks from main roads in the Hualngoram region from 15 June to 31 October to reduce rainy-season damage.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: ULA/AA names Paletwa a district of Rakhine
events.text: The ULA/AA designated Paletwa Township as one of eight districts of Rakhine State under its Arakan People's Revolutionary Government.

events.title: Malaria in 65 Paletwa Council villages
events.text: The head of the Paletwa Council's Health Department reported malaria outbreaks in 65 villages under its control.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Global Khumi Organization objects to AA claim on Paletwa
events.text: The Global Khumi Organization strongly objected to the ULA/AA designating Paletwa Township as a district of Rakhine State.

events.title: Paletwa Council gives rice to displaced in Lawngtlai
events.text: The Paletwa Council's Humanitarian Department gave 130 bags of rice and food to displaced Chin and flood-affected people in three villages of Lawngtlai District on 7-8 June, and 180 more bags of rice, 100 tarpaulins and 130 toilet pipes on 17 June.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Chin Brotherhood: Paletwa is part of Chin State
events.text: The Chin Brotherhood spokesperson said all Chin alliance members consider Paletwa Township part of Chin State, not a district of Rakhine State.

events.title: Lautu bans trade in rare orchids
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration banned extracting or trading rare orchids and required permits for collecting or trading tree roots and bulbs.

events.title: Paletwa schools appeal for textbooks
events.text: The Paletwa Township Education Board appealed to donors for textbooks, stationery and furniture for community schools for the 2025-2026 academic year.

events.others: 18 armed groups under the Chinland Council
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: 18 Chinland Council groups urge no fighting among Chins
events.text: Eighteen armed groups under the Chinland Council urged all Chin forces to fight the common enemy, settle territorial and ethnic disputes politically after the revolution and not turn weapons on each other; the CNA spokesperson said the same.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Central YMA tells refugees to follow local rules
events.text: The Central Young Mizo Association urged camp leaders, support groups and Chin parliamentarians to make refugees follow local rules, avoid drugs and crime, and apply for temporary residency cards rather than Indian citizenship documents.

events.detail: Chin villages in Minbya Township, Rakhine State
events.title: Malaria kills three in Minbya Chin villages
events.text: Malaria outbreaks in Chin villages of Minbya Township, Rakhine State, had killed three people including a child since late May, for lack of medicine and health care.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Chin refugees rally in Delhi on World Refugee Day
events.text: On World Refugee Day the Chin Refugee Committee-New Delhi demonstrated at Jantar Mantar, calling on UNHCR to recognize displaced Myanmar nationals in India as refugees.

events.title: Mindat-Matupi road reopened
events.text: The Mindat Township People's Administration reopened the Mindat-Matupi road after repairing landslide damage.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram to register 30,000 refugees from July
events.text: Mizoram's Home Department said biometric registration of over 30,000 people displaced from Myanmar in 11 districts would start in July.

events.others: Hakha Township Public Healthcare and IDPs Management Committee
events.title: Power cuts stop Hakha clinic oxygen plant
events.text: Power cuts disrupted the oxygen plant at Agape Clinic in Hakha; a local health committee appealed for funds for a generator.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA restricts internet in Paletwa
events.text: Residents reported that the Arakan Army was restricting Starlink and internet use in Paletwa Township, causing an information blackout.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.title: Mindat seeks views on forest policy
events.text: The Mindat Township People's Administration invited public suggestions on the draft forest policy for Mindat Township.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram CM warns refugees who break the law
events.text: Mizoram's Chief Minister told a Ministry of External Affairs official that strong action would be taken against displaced people from Myanmar who break Indian law.

events.title: PDF-Zoland repairs Tedim village roads
events.text: The Zomi Federal Union/PDF-Zoland had been repairing landslide-damaged inter-village roads in Tedim Township for over a month.

incidents.actors: Maraland Defense Force and Arakan Army vs CDF-Mara
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
incidents.title: CDF-Mara clashes with Maraland force and AA
incidents.text: The CDF-Mara headquarters clashed with a column of about 100 troops from the Maraland Defense Force and its ally the Arakan Army, according to a CDF-Mara official.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
incidents.title: CNDF captures Rihkhawdar from HPO
incidents.text: After fighting from 2 to 5 July, the Chin National Organization/Chin National Defense Force captured Rihkhawdar town, held by HPO/CDF-Hualngoram, including the CNA Brigade 4 headquarters.

incidents.actors: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces retake Mualpi, junta retreats to Kalay
incidents.text: Chinland Council and Chin Brotherhood forces retook positions at Mualpi village held by a junta column of about 800 troops; the junta lost many soldiers and retreated to Kalay, and weapons and ammunition were seized.

incidents.title: CNA captures CNDF headquarters
incidents.text: The Chin National Army captured the CNO/CNDF headquarters; CNDF withdrew from Rihkhawdar after five days.

incidents.title: Hakha council seizes 3 million tablets and 110 kg heroin
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha Central Council stopped two vehicles carrying about 3 million stimulant tablets and 110 kg of heroin; those involved carried a recommendation letter from a junta-aligned Battalion 15 commander in Yinmarbin. The drugs were burned.

incidents.title: Homes looted in Rihkhawdar after CNDF withdrawal
incidents.text: Residents returning to Rihkhawdar after CNDF withdrew reported 13 homes burglarized and more than 21 motorcycles and cash missing.

incidents.actors: Narcotics Control Bureau and Assam Rifles
incidents.title: Heroin and meth worth 367 million rupees seized in Champhai
incidents.text: A joint NCB and Assam Rifles operation in Champhai District seized 642 grams of heroin and 10.44 kg of methamphetamine worth 367.9 million rupees. Suspects not reported.

incidents.title: Junta bombs CDF-Matupi headquarters
incidents.text: The junta dropped a 500-pound bomb targeting the CDF-Matupi headquarters. No damage was reported.

incidents.title: Junta raids internet cafes in Hakha
incidents.text: Junta forces raided internet cafes run by Chinland Network and Shwe Hakha in Pyitawtha ward, Hakha, and confiscated their equipment.

incidents.title: HPO burns seized drugs
incidents.text: The Hualngoram People's Organization burned 280,300 stimulant tablets, 430 packages of heroin and 4 units of crystal methamphetamine seized between 9 May and 9 June (not counted again as new seizures).

incidents.title: Landmine injures two women in Mindat
incidents.text: A landmine explosion in Mindat town injured two women; one lost a leg.

events.others: Interim Council of Myanmar Nursing and Midwifery Training School
events.title: Chinland opens second nursing diploma intake
events.text: The Chinland Government's Ministry of Health and Sport announced the second intake of a three-year Diploma in Nursing and Midwifery.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram begins refugee biometric registration
events.text: Mizoram's Home Department said biometric registration of over 32,000 Myanmar refugees in the state had begun.

events.title: Hakha council calls young men back for training
events.text: CDF-Hakha/Hakha Central Council urged young men not to leave Hakha Township and called on youth abroad or elsewhere to return before the end of July for reserve military training.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chinland Council and Brotherhood urge HPO-CNDF talks
events.text: The Chinland Council and the Chin Brotherhood separately urged HPO/CDF-Hualngoram and CNO/CNDF to seek peaceful dialogue; the fighting threatened the planned Chin National Council.

events.title: 3,000 flee Rihkhawdar fighting to Mizoram
events.text: Fighting between CDF-Hualngoram and CNDF from 2 to 5 July drove over 3,000 civilians from Rihkhawdar and nearby villages to Zokhawthar, Mizoram. A woman drowned crossing the Tio River.

events.others: Advocacy Group for Peace led by the Mizoram Chief Minister's political adviser
events.title: Mizoram CM adviser meets HPO and CNDF
events.text: An advocacy group for peace led by Pu Lalmuanpuia Punte, political adviser to Mizoram's Chief Minister, met HPO and CNDF leaders near the border and urged them to avoid irreparable mistakes and human rights violations.

events.title: Paletwa Council rejects tribal conflict
events.text: The Paletwa Council said it would not support or join any Chin revolutionary group causing tribal or territorial conflict during the resistance.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Refugees protest at UNHCR Delhi
events.text: About 500 refugees from Myanmar and Afghanistan protested at the UNHCR office in New Delhi from 7 July, led by the Chin Refugee Committee, demanding refugee status, refugee cards and protection; police tried to disperse the 17-day protest on 29 July.

events.others: National Unity Consultative Council; Acting President
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: NUCC and NUG urge Chin groups to stop fighting
events.text: The NUCC, the NUG and the Acting President separately urged Chin resistance forces to stop settling internal disputes by force and pursue political dialogue.

events.others: Chin Peace and Reconciliation Initiatives (Chin religious leaders, United States)
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chin church leaders in US urge end to hate speech
events.text: Chin religious leaders in the United States called on Chin resistance groups to stop hate speech and incitement online and avoid military solutions to internal conflicts.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CDF-Ngawnngam urges Ngawn clan to stay out
events.text: CDF-Ngawnngam urged the Ngawn clan group not to get involved in conflicts related to CNO/CNDF and stressed Chin national unity.

events.title: India says Kaladan project ready by 2027
events.text: India's Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways said the Kaladan project linking Sittwe and Paletwa would be fully operational by 2027.

events.title: 18 health scholarships for Chin students
events.text: The Chin Health Organization announced 18 scholarships for Chin students to study health courses (nursing, physiotherapy, prosthetics, X-ray and laboratory technology) at Indian universities.

events.title: CNF says it will not seize towns held by Chin forces
events.text: The CNF/CNA said it had no intention of seizing townships already held by Chin revolutionary forces and would focus on protecting civilians.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chin Civil Movement calls for talks
events.text: The Chin Civil Movement called for an immediate end to armed approaches and for political dialogue among Chin revolutionary forces.

events.title: CDM health workers urge end to hate speech
events.text: CDM health workers urged civilians to avoid hate speech, resistance groups to settle conflicts politically without disrupting public services, and media not to promote ethnic hatred.

events.title: Chin National University hires staff
events.text: Chin National University, under the Chinland Council and Ministry of Education, invited applications for over 20 academic posts.

events.title: Lautu destroys expired medicines in 18 villages
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration confiscated and destroyed expired medicines and food in 18 villages, including Hnaring.

events.title: Mara council vice chair arrested with arms in Tuipang
events.text: Mizoram Police and Assam Rifles arrested two local youths and the Vice Chairman of the Maraland Territorial Council in Tuipang for possessing weapons and ammunition; the Vice Chairman was released on 29 July.

events.detail: From Para village, Mara region, to Siaha District, Mizoram
events.title: Mara council builds border road to Siaha
events.text: Construction began on a border road from Para village in the Mara region to Siaha District, Mizoram, led by the Maraland Territorial Council.

events.title: ZZLMS urge dialogue, not arms
events.text: Five groups (CDF-Zophei, CDF-Zotung, CDF-Lautu, CDF-Mara and Senthang Revolution Force, known as ZZLMS) urged that political differences be settled through dialogue, not arms.

events.title: Chinland seeks nurse instructors
events.text: The Chinland Council, Government and Ministry of Health and Sports advertised for three experienced nurse instructors for a new nursing school.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Champhai YMA bars refugees from separate churches
events.text: The Champhai sub-headquarters of the Young Mizo Association barred displaced people from Myanmar from forming separate churches or tribe-based religious organizations.

events.title: CNF warns of junta cyber warfare
events.text: The CNF/A warned Chin revolutionary forces to beware of junta cyber warfare tactics and stay focused on revolutionary goals.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Champhai to start refugee biometrics
events.text: Biometric data collection for Myanmar refugees in Champhai town was set to begin on 31 July, according to the District Commissioner.

incidents.title: Junta arrests about 40 youths in Hakha
incidents.text: The junta arrested about 40 youths in Hakha, some returning from Sunday church service and others at a tea shop on the Hakha-Gangaw road; eight were later released.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages eight homes in Mindat
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Mindat town at 8:50 AM damaged two government buildings and eight civilian homes, according to the Mindat Township Public Administration.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
incidents.title: HPO detains CNDF official at checkpoint
incidents.text: HPO/CDF-Hualngoram detained the Assistant Executive Secretary-1 of CNO/CNDF at a military checkpoint; he was released on 24 August as a gesture towards peace.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha attacks junta police vehicle
incidents.text: At about 11:30 AM CDF-Hakha attacked a vehicle of a junta police territorial security unit at Thita junction, Hakha; one police officer was seriously injured and one member killed.

incidents.title: Junta arrests ten youths after church in Hakha
incidents.text: The junta arrested ten youths returning from church near Myoma market, Pyitawtha ward, Hakha.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages five homes in Kanpetlet
incidents.text: A morning junta airstrike dropped two bombs on Kanpetlet town, damaging five civilian homes.

incidents.detail: Chyan Pyan village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Old mortar round injures four children in Chyan Pyan
incidents.text: An abandoned 60mm round exploded while children were playing near a house in Chyan Pyan village, injuring four children.

incidents.title: Junta fire near Hakha clock tower kills one
incidents.text: Junta forces opened fire near the clock tower in Hakha at about 11:30 AM, injuring a man and two female students; the man later died in hospital.

incidents.actors: Maraland Defense Force and Arakan Army vs CDF-Mara
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
incidents.title: Maraland force and AA attack CDF-Mara headquarters
incidents.text: About 200 troops from the Maraland Defense Force and the allied Arakan Army launched an offensive to seize the CDF-Mara headquarters; CDF-Mara told residents to avoid travel, not gather in groups of more than five and temporarily close schools.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Zangzawl, child injured
incidents.text: At about 1:30 PM the junta bombed Zangzawl village together with neighbouring Mualbem; one child from Zangzawl was injured.

incidents.title: Junta drops seven bombs on Mualbem and Zangzawl
incidents.text: At about 1:30 PM the junta dropped seven bombs on Mualbem and Zangzawl villages (recorded as one attack per village).

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
Cross-border trade routes
events.title: CNF and HPO sign five-point agreement
events.text: The CNF/A and the Hualngoram People's Organization signed a five-point agreement on Chinland's liberation and building, including CNF/A taking charge of checks on Trade Route No. 2 at the India-Myanmar border.

events.title: Zotung council sets road weight limits
events.text: The Zotung Federal Council issued transport rules banning loads above set weight limits on roads under repair in the Zotung region.

events.others: University of Medicine (1); Interim University Council
events.title: Chinland opens first MBBS programme
events.text: The Chinland Council, Government and Ministry of Health and Sports offered places to 30 students in the first MBBS program, with the University of Medicine (1) and the Interim University Council, starting January 2026.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: UNHCR starts refugee interviews in Delhi
events.text: UNHCR was to begin Refugee Status Determination interviews for Myanmar refugees in New Delhi from 8 August, according to the Chin Refugee Committee-New Delhi.

events.title: Chin Brotherhood visits KIO in Laiza
events.text: Chin Brotherhood representatives visited Laiza in late July at the invitation of the KIO/KIA and met its Deputy Chairman and senior NUG leaders.

events.title: Tedim council gives rice to displaced people
events.text: The Tedim Township Council distributed rice for the second time to displaced people in villages across Tedim Township; no details were released.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: 2,000 refugees registered in Mizoram biometrics
events.text: About 2,000 Myanmar refugees in Mizoram had been registered in biometric data collection from late July to 11 August.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA makes Paletwa a district under its rule
events.text: The ULA/AA spokesperson announced that Paletwa Township, taken from the junta, was being made a district-level unit under AA administration.

events.others: Chin Civic Movement; Global Khumi Youth Association
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Chin groups reject AA move on Paletwa
events.text: The Chin Civic Movement said the ULA/AA's unilateral incorporation of Paletwa into Rakhine State was unacceptable; the Global Khumi Organization and Global Khumi Youth Association said the Chin people of Paletwa do not accept it.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: CNA warns AA rule in Paletwa may cause conflict
events.text: The CNA spokesperson warned that the ULA/AA running Paletwa as a district of Rakhine State without local consent could escalate the conflict.

events.title: Tedim arrests merchant with fake kyat notes
events.text: The Tedim Township Public Administration arrested a merchant in a village with counterfeit 10,000-kyat notes worth over 100 million kyats.

issues: Opium and drug control
events.title: CNF rejects claim CNA backs drug traffickers
events.text: The CNF/A rejected as baseless an India Tribune article alleging that the CNA supports drug traffickers, and asked for a review of its sources.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: CNA vows to make junta election fail
events.text: The CNA spokesperson said it would not accept the junta's planned election (phase 1, 28 December) and would work to make it fail, warning supporters to reconsider.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: ICNCC rejects junta election
events.text: The Interim Chin National Consultative Council rejected the junta's election and urged international governments to oppose it.

events.title: Chinland Council meets on finance and restructuring
events.text: The Chinland Council's 5/2025 meeting in Chinlung discussed 2025 financing, a committee to appoint leaders and restructuring the Chinland Government and its ministries.

events.others: Chinland Council, Chinland Government and Matupi Township Public Administration (accused)
issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: MRO condemns forced conscription in Matupi
events.text: MRO/CDF-Matupi condemned the forced conscription of youths, students and married men under 40 in its areas and in areas run by the Chinland Council and Matupi Township Public Administration, warning it could escalate conflict.

events.others: ZZLMS coalition (CDF-Zotung, Zophei, Lautu, Mara and Senthang Revolution Force)
events.title: ZZLMS hold first joint military training
events.text: The ZZLMS coalition of five groups based in Hakha, Thantlang and Matupi Townships held its first joint military training.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: HPO releases CNDF official
events.text: HPO/CDF-Hualngoram released the CNO/CNDF Assistant Executive Secretary-1, detained since 5 August, as a gesture towards peace.

events.title: Mizoram: 185 Myanmar nationals arrested for drugs
events.text: Mizoram Police said 185 Myanmar nationals had been arrested for drug trafficking since 2021; a Special Drive on Drugs with the Central Young Mizo Association began field operations in border villages on 25 August.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram says border fence is Delhi's decision
events.text: Mizoram's Home Minister told the Legislative Assembly that border fencing is a central government matter being carried out on its directions.

events.others: Chin Center for Peace and Reconciliation (CCPR)
events.title: CCPR publishes report on border drug trade
events.text: CCPR published 'A New Front: Drug Trafficking Along the India-Myanmar Border', identifying Champhai District and Falam Township as main routes and about 2.7 tons of drugs seized between 2022 and July 2025.

incidents.detail: Pangkhuar village, near the Tio River
incidents.title: Drug suspect drowns fleeing arrest in Tio River
incidents.text: A man from Salen village, Thantlang Township, was arrested with narcotics in Pangkhuar village; he tried to flee and drowned in the Tio River at the border.

incidents.title: Two Falam women arrested with heroin in Serchhip
incidents.text: Two women from Seipui and Leilet villages, Falam Township, were arrested with heroin in Serchhip town at about 11 AM (amount not reported).

incidents.detail: Laeshi village on the Mindat-Matupi road (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Killing in house break-in at Laeshi
incidents.text: A house break-in and killing took place in Laeshi village at about 11 AM; the suspect, from Saw Township, is being pursued, according to the Mindat Township Public Administration.

incidents.detail: Kyan Thar village, southern Kalay Township
incidents.title: Junta counter-offensive on Kyan Thar village
incidents.text: The junta launched a counter-offensive with about 200 troops to retake Kyan Thar village in southern Kalay Township, which CDF-Kalay-Kabaw-Gangaw had held; heavy fighting followed and the briefing summary reports the village was retaken.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Khapan, one injured
incidents.text: At about noon the junta dropped three bombs on Khapan village, injuring one civilian.

incidents.title: Man arrested with 115 g heroin on Champhai road
incidents.text: Mizoram Police arrested a man from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 115 grams of heroin on the Champhai-Aizawl highway at about 9 PM.

incidents.title: Man arrested with heroin near Champhai
incidents.text: A man from Kalay was arrested with 37 grams of heroin at a checkpoint between Champhai and Aizawl.

incidents.title: 2.4 kg of meth seized at Tio River
incidents.text: Mizoram Police seized 2.372 kg of methamphetamine tablets at the Tio River crossing; the suspect fled back into Myanmar.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages seven homes in Mindat
incidents.text: At about 10 PM the junta air force dropped four bombs on two locations in Mindat town, damaging seven civilian homes. Counted as one attack (same town, same time).

incidents.title: Falam woman arrested with heroin in Champhai
incidents.text: A woman from Falam Township was arrested with 119 grams of heroin at a checkpoint in Champhai.

incidents.title: Falam woman arrested with heroin in Aizawl
incidents.text: A woman from Falam Township was arrested with 127 grams of heroin in Zemabawk East ward, Aizawl.

incidents.title: Bombs on Paletwa town kill two, injure 19
incidents.text: At about 12:30 PM the junta dropped three 500-pound bombs on Paletwa town, killing two women, injuring 19 people and damaging public infrastructure. Counted as one attack.

events.others: Customs, narcotics control and the Central Young Lai Association
events.title: Mizoram starts four-month drug operation
events.text: A four-month special operation by Mizoram police, customs, narcotics control and the Central Young Lai Association against drug trafficking from Myanmar began.

events.title: Chin National University opens second diploma batch
events.text: The Chinland Council and Ministry of Education announced that batch 2 of the Chin National University Pre-College Diploma Program would start in November 2025.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA controls border crossing at Shinletwa
events.text: Since August the Arakan Army has been issuing temporary border-crossing permits and controlling movement at the India-Myanmar border at Shinletwa village, Paletwa Township.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Junta files election case against Chinland leaders
events.text: The junta filed a case at Hakha police station under its new election law against the Chinland Council Chairman, the Chinland Government Prime Minister and 16 Council members, accusing them of speeches and mobilisation to disrupt the election.

events.title: Robberies rise on Paletwa-Kyauktaw road
events.text: Robberies and threats on the Paletwa-Kyauktaw highway rose sharply, leaving Paletwa residents afraid to travel to Kyauktaw for health, social and economic needs.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Worry over AA ban on other armed groups
events.text: Residents were increasingly worried about the ULA/AA's August statement banning the entry of any other armed group.

events.detail: Htawhawi suspension bridge between Lautu and Mara regions
events.title: Htawhawi bridge being rebuilt
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Construction and Lautu regional leaders inspected the rebuilding of the Htawhawi suspension bridge connecting the Lautu and Mara regions.

events.title: Displaced mother and triplets die in Hriphi
events.text: In Hriphi village, Thantlang Township, a displaced woman gave birth to triplets; the mother and all three babies died.

events.type: Harvest loss, crop pest or disease
events.title: Pests damage crops in 40 Mindat villages
events.text: Over 40 villages in Mindat Township reported widespread damage to crops, maize and vegetables from pests.

events.title: School collapses in storm in Ngalang
events.text: A community-built school building in Ngalang village, Thantlang Township, collapsed in strong wind and heavy rain, disrupting classes.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: MRO ignores talks on student conscription
events.text: MRO/CDF-Matupi ignored four requests for dialogue on the forced conscription of under-age students and education staff; the NUG Ministry of Education and Matupi Township Education Board urged it to respect the right to education.

events.detail: Four villages near the Mara conflict
events.title: Chinland aids people displaced by Mara fighting
events.text: With fighting ongoing since 18 July between the Maraland Defense Force with the Arakan Army and CDF-Mara, the Chinland Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs gave 100,000 MMK per household to displaced families from four villages.

events.title: Mindat carries out population census
events.text: The Mindat Township Public Administration completed a population census of more than half of Mindat Township to plan public services.

events.title: Fever kills seven young children in Mindat
events.text: A seasonal fever outbreak in Mindat Township killed seven children under five in 2025, according to the Township Department of Health.

events.detail: Mindat, Matupi, Kanpetlet and Paletwa Townships
issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Junta cancels voting in 11 southern constituencies
events.text: The junta's Union Election Commission announced that elections would not be held in 11 constituencies in Mindat, Matupi, Kanpetlet and Paletwa Townships.

events.title: Dengue kills five children in Daai region
events.text: Five children in the Daai region died of dengue between June and 15 September; medical supplies and health services were urgently needed.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Lawngtlai bans fertiliser export to Myanmar
events.text: The Lawngtlai District Commissioner banned the export of chemical fertiliser to Myanmar for two months, citing its use in mining.

events.detail: Road between Mindat and M'kuiimnu town
events.title: Landslides block Mindat road
events.text: Landslides from continuous rain blocked the road between Mindat and M'kuiimnu town, disrupting the supply of essential goods.

events.title: Chinland hospitals open to all Chin people
events.text: The Chinland Minister of Health said hospitals and clinics under the Ministry serve all Chin people regardless of political affiliation.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Kanpetlet police order CDM officers to join
events.text: The People's Police Force under CDF-Kanpetlet told CDM police officers to join by the end of October or face consequences.

events.detail: Forest near Saikhumphai, close to Leilet village (Falam)
events.title: Assam Rifles find weapons near Leilet
events.text: Assam Rifles found and seized a G3 rifle, a sniper rifle, a 60mm mortar and equipment in a forest near Saikhumphai, close to Leilet village in Falam Township.

events.title: CDF-Daai marks fourth anniversary
events.text: On its fourth anniversary CDF-Daai restated its commitment to unite the Daai people under a federal state government, end military dictatorship and work with other Chin forces on nation and state building.
