events.title: Chin man arrested with rifle in Zokhawthar
events.text: Assam Rifles and Mizoram Police arrested a Chin man with a rifle and ammunition in Zokhawthar, near border trade post No. 2.

events.title: Thantlang-Zophei road repaired
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Construction said the rain-damaged road between Thantlang town and the Zophei area had been repaired with local community leaders and reopened.

events.title: Chin National University's first 140 graduates
events.text: The Chin National University held its first pre-college diploma graduation: 140 students received a Diploma in Community Development, with the Parliament Speaker, Prime Minister and Education Minister attending.

incidents.detail: Eastern ward and a hotel in the western ward
incidents.title: Airstrikes on Mindat injure three
incidents.text: At about 1:30 AM junta airstrikes hit a site in the eastern ward of Mindat town and a hotel in the western ward, injuring three civilians and damaging the hotel. Counted as one attack (same town, same time).

incidents.title: Airstrike on Htin Chaung school kills four students
incidents.text: At about 7 PM a junta airstrike hit the Catholic church and school in Htin Chaung village, killing four students and injuring about 15 others; the buildings caught fire and collapsed.

incidents.detail: School in Vamthu village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Junta bombs Vamthu village school
incidents.text: At the same time as the Htin Chaung strike, the junta bombed the school in Vamthu village, damaging the building.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Matupi near fire station
incidents.text: The junta bombed the area near the fire station in Matupi town at about 8 PM; residents reported deaths, injuries and damage (numbers not given).

incidents.title: Two arrested with 1.6 kg heroin in Champhai
incidents.text: Champhai District Police arrested two men, one from Khawthir village in Falam Township and one from Sagaing Region, with 1.627 kg of heroin on the Union highway.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Vanhar school kills two students
incidents.text: At about 10:30 AM the junta bombed the school in Vanhar village, killing two students, injuring 21 others and badly damaging the school.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages Matupi hospital
incidents.text: At about 7 AM an airstrike hit the area near the General Public Hospital in Matupi town, damaging the hospital building.

incidents.detail: Fire Station Hill and Khuavung ward
incidents.title: Airstrike destroys three homes in Tonzang
incidents.text: The junta air force bombed Fire Station Hill and Khuavung ward in Tonzang town, destroying three civilian homes.

incidents.title: CDF-Mara detains three CDM teachers
incidents.text: CDF-Mara detained three CDM teachers from the Matupi Township Education Board, accusing them of refusing to support its draft local governance law.

incidents.title: Man arrested with 1.2 kg heroin in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Mizoram Police arrested a man from Ward 2, Rihkhawdar, in Zokhawthar with 1.215 kg of heroin.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha attacks Hakha police station, frees 15
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha attacked the Hakha town police station in the morning; five junta troops were killed and 15 detainees were freed.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Matupi town
incidents.text: The junta carried out an airstrike on a site in Matupi town at about 4 PM; no information on damage was released.

incidents.title: Poppy seeds seized near Ruangtlang
incidents.text: Assam Rifles seized 90 bags of poppy seeds and 120 bags of betel nuts smuggled from Myanmar near Ruangtlang village; the owner is unknown.

incidents.detail: Hmantaw village, southern Kalay Township; Kalay-Gangaw road
incidents.title: CDF-KKG loses Hmantaw village
incidents.text: CDF-Kalay-Kabaw-Gangaw lost control of Hmantaw village in southern Kalay Township after a junta counter-offensive with a larger force; fighting continued along the Kalay-Gangaw road.

incidents.title: Junta troops move from Kalay towards Chinland
incidents.text: Four junta vehicles carrying troops advanced from Kalay towards Chinland on the Kalay-Tedim road in the evening, according to local sources.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Zathal school
incidents.text: At about 1 PM the junta bombed Zathal village in the Senthang area, damaging a school building and a home.

incidents.title: Bombs on Kanpetlet wedding kill four
incidents.text: The junta dropped two bombs on a wedding ceremony of a CDF-Kanpetlet commander in Ward 2, Kanpetlet town, killing three men and one woman, injuring 15 others and destroying four homes. Recorded as a civilian area (a wedding).

incidents.title: Junta bombs Kanpetlet fire station
incidents.text: The junta bombed Kanpetlet town at about 8:30 PM, damaging the fire station and three staff residences.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Khonu Center in Mindat
incidents.text: The junta carried out two aerial bombings on the Khonu Center in Mindat town on 26 and 27 October, damaging buildings; casualties were not known. Counted as two attacks (two days).

incidents.title: Junta flies reinforcements into Tedim
incidents.text: Local sources said the junta flew reinforcements 26 times by Mi-17 helicopter from Kalay to Infantry Battalion 269 in Tedim town between 26 and 29 October.

incidents.detail: Kyunchaung and Htukkyat villages near the Kalay-Gangaw road, southern Kalay Township
incidents.title: Junta burns homes in Kyunchaung
incidents.text: Over 100 junta troops raided Kyunchaung village near the Kalay-Gangaw road at about 1 PM and burned several homes; on 28 October they attacked Htukkyat village and burned houses.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Taingen, woman injured
incidents.text: At about 10 PM the junta bombed Taingen (Tai-ngin) village in the Siyin area, injuring a woman and destroying a home.

incidents.title: Junta troops advance towards Tonzang, turn back
incidents.text: About 100 troops from Infantry Battalion 269 advanced on the Tedim-Tonzang road towards Tonzang but turned back halfway the same day, according to the CDF-Tonzang commander.

incidents.title: Junta offensive from Kalay and Tedim, fighting near Mualpi
incidents.text: About 200 troops from Kalay and 200 from Tedim advanced on the Kalay-Dingin and Tedim-Dingin routes; fighting broke out with CDF-CDM Siyin near Mualpi (Hmualpi) village in the afternoon.

incidents.detail: About six miles outside Tedim on the Tedim-Dingin-Kalay road
incidents.title: PDF-Zoland fights junta outside Tedim
incidents.text: About 200 junta troops advancing from Tedim on the Tedim-Dingin-Kalay road fought PDF-Zoland about six miles outside Tedim.

incidents.detail: Ha-Khalay village, Zanniatram area (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Junta burns homes in Ha-Khalay
incidents.text: Junta troops operating along the Kalay-Gangaw road entered Ha-Khalay village in the Zanniatram area of Falam Township and burned several homes.

events.others: ACR, CRC, Dai Community and FRO (Malaysia)
events.title: Malaysia Chin groups meet on refugee support
events.text: Four Malaysia-based Chin organisations held a two-day meeting with Chin leaders, pastors and community groups to coordinate support for Chin refugees in Malaysia.

events.title: Junta releases ten Hakha youths
events.text: Ten of the sixteen youths arrested by the junta in August while returning from church in Hakha were released.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram refugee registration 37% done
events.text: Mizoram's Home Department said biometric registration of displaced people from Myanmar, begun in late July, was 37.4 percent complete.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA releases Daletza man after two weeks
events.text: A Chin resident of Daletza village, Paletwa Township, was released after more than two weeks in Arakan Army detention on accusations of leaking information about cross-border passports in Mizoram.

events.detail: 13 locations in Tedim and Mindat Townships and Mizoram
events.title: Food aid to displaced in Tedim, Mindat and Mizoram
events.text: The Network for Chin Community Development distributed food to displaced Chin people at 13 locations in Tedim and Mindat Townships and Mizoram.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.title: Chinland Council visits Thado and Tonzang
events.text: A Chinland Council delegation led by its Vice President 2 with ministers made field visits and held public meetings in the Thado and Tonzang areas.

events.title: 20 groups urge ASEAN to reject junta election
events.text: A coalition of 20 organisations including the CNF, NUG and KNU urged ASEAN not to recognise any junta-run election, to act to protect civilians and to demand the release of political prisoners.

events.title: Six armed groups urge boycott of NCA anniversary
events.text: Six ethnic armed organisations including the CNF urged the UN, ASEAN and diplomats not to attend the junta's 15 October ceremony for the 10th anniversary of the Nationwide Ceasefire Agreement.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Hakha council calls for election boycott
events.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council condemned junta airstrikes on civilians, called for a full boycott of the election, warned of action against participants and urged international pressure to stop attacks.

events.title: Chinland condemns airstrikes on schools
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Education condemned junta airstrikes on schools and schoolchildren and called for urgent international action.

events.detail: Gangaw-Aika and Hakha-Matupi routes, Zotung region
events.title: Landslides cut Gangaw-Aika and Hakha-Matupi roads
events.text: The Zotung Federal Council said heavy rain had caused severe landslides on the Gangaw-Aika and Hakha-Matupi roads, disrupting cargo, and that large funding is needed for repairs.

events.title: Explosives seized in Vaphai heading to Myanmar
events.text: Assam Rifles arrested two men in Vaphai village near the border trying to smuggle explosives into Myanmar: 5,800 gelatin sticks, 10,500 metres of Cordtex fuse and 6,000 detonators.

events.title: Chin National University adds three faculties
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Education announced three new faculties at Chin National University (Education, Law, and Technical and Vocational Studies) opening in January 2026.

events.detail: Villages near the Kalay-Tamu and Kalay-Gangaw roads
events.title: 10,000 flee junta offensive near Kalay
events.text: Over 10,000 civilians fled villages near the Kalay-Tamu and Kalay-Gangaw roads during large junta offensives and urgently needed food, according to the Kalay People's Defense Committee.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Mindat rewards vehicle owners who helped resistance
events.text: The Mindat Public Administration said vehicle owners who carried supplies for the resistance during the Mindat operation, and hold contribution certificates, are exempt from checkpoint taxes in the township.

events.title: Night curfew in Hakha
events.text: Citing airstrikes on civilians and junta reinforcements for the election, the CDF-Hakha Central Council imposed a night curfew in Hakha.

events.title: CNF marks KIO anniversary
events.text: On the 65th anniversary of the KIO/KIA the CNF reaffirmed shared goals with the Kachin, the NUG and other revolutionary forces.

events.detail: Motorcycle routes between Kalay and Tedim
events.title: CDF-CDM Siyin closes Kalay-Tedim motorbike routes
events.text: Because of a large junta offensive on the Siyin area, CDF-CDM Siyin temporarily closed motorcycle routes between Kalay and Tedim.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Chinland Council opposes junta election
events.text: The Chinland Council opposed the junta's December 2025 election, warned that participation by non-CDM civil servants would legitimise military rule, urged Chin people to stay away and asked the world not to recognise it.

events.others: Thantlang council Education Department; Senthang Central Council; Kanpetlet and Mindat Township Administrations
events.title: Thantlang closes schools over airstrikes
events.text: Because of continued airstrikes on schools, the Thantlang council's Education Department closed all community schools in its area indefinitely; Senthang Central Council and the Kanpetlet and Mindat administrations had done the same earlier in October.

incidents.title: Junta abducts 14 from Suangpi as guides
incidents.text: The junta abducted 14 civilians from Suangpi village to serve as guides; they were rescued on 6 November.

incidents.detail: CDF-Hakha checkpoint on the Hakha-Matupi road
incidents.title: Junta attacks CDF-Hakha checkpoint, one killed
incidents.text: A junta column attacked a CDF-Hakha checkpoint near Loklung village on the Hakha-Matupi road, killing one resistance fighter.

incidents.detail: Nat Chaung village, southern Kalay Township
incidents.title: Junta burns homes, kills two in Nat Chaung
incidents.text: In Nat Chaung village, southern Kalay Township, junta troops burned eight homes and killed two men, leaving their bodies in an irrigation canal.

incidents.title: Junta retakes Kennedy Mountain camp
incidents.text: Junta troops from Light Infantry Battalion 269 attacked along the Kalay-Taingen road and retook the Kennedy Mountain camp held by PDF-Zoland.

incidents.detail: Kanparni camp on the Kalay-Gangaw road, southern Kalay Township
incidents.actors: Junta and Pyu Saw Htee militia vs Chinland Government forces
incidents.title: Junta offensive on Kanparni camp
incidents.text: Fighting intensified as junta troops with Pyu Saw Htee militia launched a major offensive to retake Kanparni camp on the Kalay-Gangaw road, which Chin forces had taken in February 2025.

incidents.detail: Near Aa Lwe village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Junta clashes with PDF-Zoland near Aa Lwe
incidents.text: A junta column from LIB 269 clashed with PDF-Zoland near Aa Lwe village. Fourteen civilians from Suangpi village, abducted by the junta on 3 November to act as guides, were rescued; one woman among them was reported sexually assaulted by junta soldiers.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
incidents.title: AA holds Paletwa village administrator
incidents.text: A village administrator in Paletwa Township, arrested by the Arakan Army on 26 October, was still held without family contact.

incidents.title: Fighting at Taingen, 20 junta soldiers killed
incidents.text: Fighting at Taingen village between LIB 269 and CDF-CDM Siyin; over 20 junta soldiers were reported killed. Under heavy assault CDF-CDM Siyin left a junta camp it had captured.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha fires on junta police extorting money
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha fired on four junta police officers in plain clothes who were extorting money in Myo Thit ward, killing one; junta troops then fired indiscriminately, injuring four civilians and burning one house.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Ruan village
incidents.text: At about 10 PM the junta dropped four bombs on Ruan village, damaging a religious building and a house.

incidents.title: PDF-Zoland retakes Kennedy Mountain
incidents.text: PDF-Zoland announced it had retaken Kennedy Mountain camp on the Tedim-Taingen road.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages church and school in Thuklai
incidents.text: At midnight junta airstrikes hit Thuklai (Htok Lai) village in the Siyin area, damaging religious buildings and a school.

incidents.detail: Aye Thayar village, mile 22 on the Mindat-Matupi road (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Airstrike damages homes in Aye Thayar
incidents.text: At about 3 PM junta airstrikes hit Aye Thayar village, 22 miles along the Mindat-Matupi road, damaging homes.

incidents.actors: Chinland Council forces and allies vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces fight junta columns, 150 soldiers killed
incidents.text: The Chinland Council and allies fought junta columns from Kalay; about 150 junta soldiers including officers were reported killed and weapons were seized.

incidents.detail: Near Taingen and in Falam Township, 26-27 November
incidents.title: Six Chin fighters killed near Taingen and Falam
incidents.text: Heavy fighting near Taingen in Tedim Township and in Falam Township on 26-27 November; six Chin resistance fighters were killed.

incidents.title: PDF-Zoland retakes Saimual hill
incidents.text: PDF-Zoland retook a junta-held position at Saimual hill near the 'Welcome to Tedim' sign, seizing weapons and capturing two soldiers.

incidents.title: Airstrike destroys four homes in Ruan
incidents.text: At about 1 AM the junta carried out an airstrike on Ruan village, destroying four homes.

events.title: CDF-Asho gives medical care in Ngaphe
events.text: CDF-Asho said it gave medical care to 104 detainees and 127 civilians in Ngaphe Township, Magway Region, in October.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Chinland Council bans taking part in election
events.text: The Chinland Council issued eight prohibitions on taking part in the junta's election, including distributing pamphlets, and said violators would be penalised.

events.title: Woman dies in childbirth without care in Paletwa
events.text: In Chaing Sa Nu village in the Daai area of Paletwa Township, a woman died in childbirth because no health care was available.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Diarrhoea kills six Paletwa refugees in Lawngtlai
events.text: Diarrhoea broke out in early November in Karkhi and Twidan villages, Lawngtlai District, where many Paletwa refugees live: six deaths and about 54 cases by 12 November. About 300 people in the Shinletwa area of Paletwa were also affected.

events.type: Road or trade route closed or reopened
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: AA closes Mizoram-Paletwa crossings
events.text: The Arakan Army closed border crossings between Mizoram and Paletwa during the diarrhoea outbreak.

events.title: 20,000 displaced by junta offensive in Falam
events.text: The CNO/CNDF spokesperson said junta offensives in Falam Township had displaced over 20,000 civilians since late October, including 3,000 children under ten, who urgently need aid.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram refugee registration 58% done
events.text: Mizoram authorities said biometric registration of over 31,000 displaced people from Myanmar was 58 percent complete.

events.type: Road or trade route closed or reopened
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Paletwa-Mizoram trade route reopens
events.text: Mizoram reopened the Paletwa-Mizoram trade route after a two-week closure because of the diarrhoea outbreak.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Mindat-Matupi road
incidents.text: At about 3 PM the junta dropped two bombs on a site on the Mindat-Matupi road, destroying two public buildings.

incidents.detail: ULA/AA checkpoint, Rhin Lat Wa village
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
incidents.title: AA arrests two Paletwa students
incidents.text: Arakan Army troops arrested two students, aged 17 and 18, from Paletwa villages at their checkpoint in Rhin Lat Wa village without giving a reason.

incidents.detail: On the way back to Bekan village
incidents.title: Landmine kills two returning to Bekan
incidents.text: Three displaced men returning to Bekan village stepped on a landmine laid by the junta; two were killed and one injured.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Kanpetlet town
incidents.text: At about 10 PM the junta bombed Kanpetlet town from the air; no details of damage were released.

incidents.detail: On the way to Phaizawl village
incidents.title: Displaced woman disappeared by junta
incidents.text: A 39-year-old woman from Kalay Township, displaced and travelling to Phaizawl village, was arrested and disappeared by junta troops.

incidents.title: Junta uses 12 Bualkhua villagers as shields
incidents.text: Junta troops took 12 civilians from Bualkhua village and were holding them as human shields.

incidents.title: Landmine kills displaced man in Bualkhua
incidents.text: A 23-year-old man displaced from Kalay Township to Bualkhua village was killed by a landmine laid by the junta.

incidents.title: Junta drops 64 bombs on Falam villages
incidents.text: The junta dropped 64 bombs on several villages in Falam Township, destroying some homes. The briefing does not give the number of separate attacks, so this is counted as one.

incidents.title: Bombs damage 15 homes in Kanpetlet village
incidents.text: At about 1 PM the junta dropped two bombs on a village in Kanpetlet Township, damaging 15 homes.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Matupi five times
incidents.text: The junta bombed Matupi town from the air at least five times on 11 December; damage was not reported. Counted as five attacks.

incidents.title: Chin forces fight junta near Sumhrang
incidents.text: Heavy fighting near Sumhrang village between junta troops and Chin joint forces; about 30 small arms, drones and ammunition were seized and one soldier captured, according to the Chinland Government's Ministry of Defence.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Matupi-Paletwa road
incidents.text: At about 9 PM the junta dropped a 500-pound bomb on mile 9 of the Matupi-Paletwa road; damage was not reported.

incidents.title: Junta drops 20 bombs around Khuangli
incidents.text: The junta dropped more than 20 bombs around Khuangli village; most villagers had already fled and the damage was not known.

incidents.title: Three arrested with heroin in Mizoram
incidents.text: The Mizoram Excise and Narcotics Department arrested two local men and a 29-year-old man from Webula, Falam Township, with 349 grams of heroin in Falkland ward, Aizawl.

incidents.title: Junta bombs old LIB 140 camp in Matupi
incidents.text: The junta dropped a 500-pound bomb on the former Light Infantry Battalion 140 camp in Matupi; damage was not reported.

incidents.detail: Roads to Nilawng, Phaipi and Khuabe villages
incidents.title: Junta digs up roads out of Hakha
incidents.text: The junta dug up roads out of Hakha with a JCB, including the roads towards Nilawng, Phaipi and Khuabe villages, so that people could not get around its checkpoints.

incidents.title: Junta bombs K. Haimual village
incidents.text: At about 3 AM the junta dropped two bombs on K. Haimual village, damaging homes.

incidents.title: Fighting near Sumhrang, junta major killed
incidents.text: Heavy fighting on the ridge near Sumhrang village; three junta soldiers including a major were killed and weapons seized, according to the Chinland Government's Ministry of Defence.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages seven homes in Mindat
incidents.text: At about 5 PM a junta airstrike on Mindat town damaged seven homes.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Loklung, church damaged
incidents.text: The junta dropped eight bombs on Loklung village, damaging a church and at least three homes.

incidents.detail: Junta camp on Rungtlang (Ran Taung) hill and two other sites
incidents.title: CDF-Hakha attacks Rungtlang hill camp
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha attacked the junta camp on Rungtlang hill above Hakha in the early morning; heavy fighting at three sites around the town. The CDF-Hakha Central Council said 15 junta soldiers were killed and weapons seized.

incidents.title: Junta shells Hakha wards during fighting
incidents.text: During heavy fighting with CDF-Hakha, junta troops fired heavy weapons into residential wards of Hakha, killing livestock and damaging some homes.

incidents.title: PDF-Zoland fights junta near Kennedy Peak
incidents.text: Heavy fighting broke out near Kennedy Peak between junta troops and PDF-Zoland from early morning.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Tiphir damages church and 19 homes
incidents.text: At about 4 AM a junta airstrike on Tiphir village damaged a church and 19 homes.

incidents.title: Junta bombs hotel in Kanpetlet
incidents.text: At about 12 noon the junta bombed the Win Hotel in Kanpetlet town; damage was not reported.

incidents.title: Chinland forces kill three junta soldiers near Khuangli
incidents.text: Fighting near Khuangli village between Chinland Government forces and junta troops; three junta soldiers were killed, four captured and ten small arms seized.

incidents.title: Junta shelling of Sezang kills schoolboy
incidents.text: At about 9 PM junta Light Infantry Battalion 269 in Tedim fired heavy weapons at Sezang village, killing an 8-year-old schoolboy and injuring a 14-year-old.

events.title: Chin National University faculties open for 2026
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Education said the Education, Law and Technology faculties of Chin National University will accept students for the 2026 academic year.

issues: Opium and drug control
events.title: UNODC: poppy growing in Chin State rises
events.text: The UNODC Myanmar opium survey said poppy cultivation in Chin State rose from 837 hectares in 2024 to 1,040 hectares in 2025, the third highest in Myanmar and the highest in 26 years.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Second Chinland Council congress meets
events.text: The second Chinland Council congress, with 202 representatives from member organisations and the Chinland Parliament, met in Chinlung from 4 to 6 December. It re-elected the Council's leaders and committees and set plans for the second term on law making, administration, the judiciary and the Chinland Government.

events.title: Mizoram CM urges Chins not to divide by tribe
events.text: At a Together for Humanity dinner in Aizawl led by ICA, Mizoram's Chief Minister said Chin affairs would not be solved by dividing along tribal lines.

events.others: Chin Gender Policy Framework Steering Committee (CGPFSC)
events.title: Chin gender policy framework adopted
events.text: The Chin Gender Policy Framework Steering Committee said a Chin gender policy framework based on equality, justice and participation was adopted at a workshop on the India-Myanmar border.

events.type: Meeting or agreement between border authorities
events.others: Mizoram University; a Chin affairs association
events.title: Mizoram University agreement for Myanmar students
events.text: A Chin affairs association and Mizoram University signed a five-year agreement on master's programmes for students from Myanmar, a Burmese diploma course and joint research.

events.title: Human Rights Day marked in Chinlung
events.text: Human Rights Day was marked in Chinlung on 10 December with talks and discussions organised by CNF departments and women's and youth groups.

events.detail: Lawktu, Simsin, Tunbo, Rimo, Lawkyabu and Hnamtla villages
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: AA forced recruitment drives Paletwa youth out
events.text: Since November, the Arakan Army's forced recruitment in Paletwa villages including Lawktu, Rimo and Hnamtla drove young people and their families to flee to Mizoram, India. The Global Khumi Organization said the AA was trying to drive Chin people out and called it ethnic cleansing.

events.others: Chin Center for Peace and Reconciliation (CCPR)
events.title: CCPR gives rice to 1,000 displaced in Tonzang
events.text: CCPR said it had given rice (8 pyi per person) to about 1,000 displaced people in five villages of Tonzang Township in December.

events.title: Chin groups condemn Kyaukphyu hospital strike
events.text: After a junta airstrike on Kyaukphyu general hospital in Rakhine State killed 35 people and injured 76, the Chinland Council and the Chin Brotherhood each called for urgent international action against the junta.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.title: Chin Brotherhood joins Spring Revolution Alliance
events.text: The Chin Brotherhood and 18 other resistance groups formed the Spring Revolution Alliance to build a federal democratic union.

events.detail: Road between Bweli and Kinkanhkon villages
events.title: CDF-Paletwa builds Bweli road
events.text: CDF-Paletwa led the building and widening of a car road between Bweli and Kinkanhkon villages in Paletwa Township.

events.title: Tedim coffee price at high
events.text: Coffee growers in Tedim Township said dried coffee was fetching its highest price since 2024 in December.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Maraland council amends defence law
events.text: The Maraland Territorial Council congress, with 78 representatives, amended its defence law, adopted a Lailenpi town administration law and formed a Political Steering Committee.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Matupi administration accuses MRO of abuses
events.text: The Matupi Township People's Administration accused MRO/CDF-Matupi of arresting and threatening its staff, blocking travel and repeatedly breaking a ceasefire agreement in areas it controls.

events.title: CDF-Paletwa bans youth from leaving
events.text: CDF-Paletwa banned young people living in Paletwa Township from leaving for other parts of Myanmar or abroad, except for health or education.

events.others: ZZLMS (Zophei, Zotung, Lautu, Mara and Sengthang defence forces)
events.title: ZZLMS call youth aged 15-35 back for duty
events.text: The ZZLMS defence forces called on people aged 15 to 35 from their areas living elsewhere to come back and take up duties with their organisations.

events.title: Senthang bans Christmas gatherings over airstrikes
events.text: Because junta airstrikes target schools, religious buildings and gatherings, the Senthang Central Council banned large gatherings, including Christmas services, until further notice.

events.title: NUG lists junta Chin State leaders as terrorists
events.text: Among 33 junta members the NUG listed as terrorists were the junta's Chin State Chief Minister and leaders of the Zomi Congress for Democracy party.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CDF-Kanpetlet recalls its ICNCC representatives
events.text: Following a Kanpetlet Township administration and defence meeting, CDF-Kanpetlet temporarily recalled its representatives from the ICNCC and the Chin Brotherhood, while saying it has not left either body.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Tedim avocado prices fall, no export
events.text: Avocado growers in Tedim Township said they could not export to Mizoram in 2025 and prices fell to about 50,000 kyats a basket.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Hakha council to seize election candidates' property
events.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council said the property in Hakha Township of candidates and parties taking part in the junta election would be seized under procedures set by the Chinland Council, and warned people not to take part.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Hakha council warns residents not to vote
events.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council warned residents of Hakha not to vote in the junta election on 28 December, saying they should stay home.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: PDF-Zoland restricts movement on election day
events.text: With the junta election on 28 December, PDF-Zoland warned Tedim town residents not to move around town and villagers not to travel to Tedim from 26 to 28 December.

events.detail: Fled to Vaphai village, Champhai District, Mizoram
events.title: 89 flee to Vaphai, Mizoram
events.text: Because of the junta offensive, 89 civilians from K. Haimual and Sumhrang villages fled to Vaphai village in Champhai District, Mizoram.

events.others: Kanpetlet Township People's Administration and forest department
events.title: Kanpetlet bans illegal logging
events.text: The Kanpetlet Township People's Administration and its forest department banned illegal logging and the starting of forest fires.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Chin Community of Japan rejects AA rule in Paletwa
events.text: The Chin Community of Japan said ULA/AA administration of Paletwa Township as part of Rakhine State, without the consent of local Chin people, violates the principles of federal democracy, and called for an end to abuses against Chin people there.

events.title: Chin Brotherhood thanks ULA/AA on anniversary
events.text: On its second anniversary the Chin Brotherhood thanked the ULA/AA and other revolutionary allies and international supporters for their help.

incidents.title: Two arrested with heroin in Champhai
incidents.text: Champhai District Police arrested two men from Khawhmawi village, Falam Township, with 86 grams of heroin in soap cases.

incidents.title: Bombing of Halta kills mother and two children
incidents.text: At about 10 PM the junta bombed Halta and Haiphai villages. In Halta two young children and their mother were killed and the father was badly injured and died the next day. Counted as two attacks (two villages).

incidents.actors: CDF-CDM Siyin and PDF-Zoland vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces retake Kennedy Peak camp
incidents.text: CDF-CDM Siyin (Chinland Council) and PDF-Zoland (Chin Brotherhood) jointly retook the junta camp on Kennedy Peak. Ten junta soldiers including a major were killed, 20 captured and about 30 small arms seized.

incidents.actors: Chinland Government forces and local joint forces vs junta
incidents.title: Chinland forces attack junta column at Khuangli
incidents.text: Chinland Government forces and local joint forces attacked a junta column based in Khuangli village; at least eight soldiers were killed, two captured, and heavy and ten small arms seized.

incidents.title: Drone bomb destroys two homes in Tedim
incidents.text: At about 6 PM, with no fighting nearby, the junta dropped a drone bomb on Leitawhtan ward, Tedim town, destroying two homes.

incidents.detail: Ruan Khuahlun village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Airstrike on Ruan Khuahlun damages homes
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Ruan Khuahlun village damaged at least three homes.

incidents.detail: Near Htin Chaung village on the Kyaukhtu-Mindat road
incidents.title: Junta bombs near Htin Chaung
incidents.text: At about 10 AM the junta bombed a site near Htin Chaung village on the Kyaukhtu-Mindat road; no damage was reported.

incidents.title: Kalay man arrested with heroin in Champhai
incidents.text: Champhai District Police arrested a 32-year-old man from Kalay with 112 grams of heroin.

incidents.title: Airstrike destroys Tibual administration office
incidents.text: At about 9 PM a junta airstrike on Tibual village destroyed the township administration office and a staff house.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC arrests two Anlun villagers
incidents.text: The junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) arrested two civilian men from Anlun village without reason, according to CDF-Tonzang.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages two churches in Lente
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Lente village damaged two churches and several homes.

incidents.actors: Chinland Government and local forces vs junta
incidents.title: Fighting near Sumhrang
incidents.text: Heavy fighting near Sumhrang village between the junta and Chinland Government and local forces, with casualties on both sides.

incidents.title: Junta column hit by mines near Zawngkawng
incidents.text: A junta column of about 200 heading from Kalay to the Siyin area was hit by mines laid by Chin resistance forces below Zawngkawng village, with junta deaths reported.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Mindat town entrance twice
incidents.text: The junta bombed the town entrance in the eastern ward of Mindat twice; no damage was officially reported. Counted as two attacks.

incidents.title: 468 g heroin seized in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Zokhawthar police found and seized 468 grams of heroin in soap cases smuggled from Rihkhawdar.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages Khuafo school
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Khuafo village damaged the village school.

incidents.title: Landmine takes displaced man's leg in New Suangpi
incidents.text: A 38-year-old displaced man going back to check his home in New Suangpi village stepped on a landmine laid by the junta and lost a leg.

incidents.title: Two Kalay people arrested with heroin in Kolasib
incidents.text: Kolasib District Police arrested two people from Kalay with 20 soap cases of heroin.

incidents.detail: Between Valung and Zaenglei villages (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.actors: Chinland Government joint forces vs junta
incidents.title: Junta reinforcements fight Chin forces near Valung
incidents.text: A junta column from Kalay sent to reinforce troops advancing on Falam fought Chinland Government joint forces between Valung and Zaenglei villages; seven junta soldiers were killed.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages five homes in Sunthla
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Sunthla village damaged five homes.

incidents.detail: CNA and CDF-Tonzang camp, Nat Chaung village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: ZRA-EC drone attack on CNA camp
incidents.text: At about 5 AM the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) attacked the joint CNA and CDF-Tonzang camp at Nat Chaung village with two drone bombs.

incidents.detail: Fired from Lumbang village, Falam Township
incidents.title: Junta shells New Suangpi, churches damaged
incidents.text: A junta column at Lumbang village in Falam Township fired heavy weapons at New Suangpi village, damaging two churches.

incidents.title: Airstrike burns three homes in Sim Dihai
incidents.text: At about 2 AM a junta airstrike on Sim Dihai village burned down three homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Nganzawl kills elderly man
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Nganzawl village killed a 70-year-old man and damaged at least 10 homes.

events.title: Chinland Council New Year call for unity
events.text: In his New Year message the Chinland Council Chairman urged Chin people not to divide their areas and to keep working together for a Chinland with self-determination.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.title: Paletwa Council holds public meetings
events.text: The Paletwa Council held public meetings at eight places in Paletwa Township to strengthen trust between the public and the revolution.

events.title: CNO repairs Kalay-Falam road
events.text: The Chin National Organization said it had repaired the Kalay-Webula-Falam road with funding from the Institute of Chin Affairs.

events.others: Chin Baptist Churches USA; Central Young Mizo Association; Central Young Lai Association
events.title: Chin Baptist Churches fund Mizoram anti-drug work
events.text: Chin Baptist Churches USA gave 1.5 lakh rupees to the Central Young Mizo Association and Central Young Lai Association for anti-drug work in Mizoram.

events.title: ICNCC congress adopts Chin National Charter
events.text: The ICNCC's first congress adopted a Chin National Charter and re-formed the ICNCC with 19 members, to run politics, administration and defence in Chin Brotherhood areas.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Few vote in junta election in Hakha and Tedim
events.text: The Chinland Council said only 6,786 people voted in the junta's first election phase in Hakha and Tedim, about 3 percent of 2020 turnout, showing the junta has no control.

events.others: Australian Senator Dean Smith; ACR, CRC and FRO
events.title: Australian senator meets Chin refugees in Malaysia
events.text: Australian Senator Dean Smith met three Chin refugee groups in Malaysia (ACR, CRC and FRO) on Chin refugee issues, 11 to 13 January.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.detail: Mindat, Kanpetlet, Matupi and Daai areas
events.others: Chin People's Union/Chin People's Army (CPU/CPA); Kanpetlet Township Council/CDF-Kanpetlet
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CPU/CPA formed, joins federal goal
events.text: The Chin People's Union/Chin People's Army said it would work with allied forces towards a federal union. It was formed on 15 December 2025 by four groups from Mindat, Kanpetlet, Matupi and the Daai region.

events.title: CHRO files case against junta in Timor-Leste
events.text: CHRO filed a case in a court in Dili, Timor-Leste, over junta abuses including the January 2022 killing of 10 civilians, a journalist and a child among them, in Matupi Township.

events.title: Hakha council lists 900 junta collaborators
events.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council published a list of over 900 people, including the junta's Chin State Chief Minister and ministers, who served junta administration from 2021 to 2025, naming them enemies of the people.

events.others: Mizo Zirlai Pawl (MZP); Zo Re-unification Organization (ZORO)
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: MZP and ZORO protest border fence
events.text: The MZP and ZORO held a joint protest at Vanapa Hall in Aizawl against India's plan to fence the India-Myanmar border.

events.title: Chin National University adds new courses
events.text: The Chinland Council and Ministry of Education announced new Chin National University courses: nursing and midwifery diplomas, business education, electrical and civil engineering, and law.

events.others: Philippine Foreign Secretary and ASEAN Special Envoy on Myanmar
events.title: ASEAN envoy meets CNF and others
events.text: The ASEAN chair's special envoy on Myanmar, the Philippine Foreign Secretary, met resistance groups including the CNF in Tagaytay on 19-20 January on ending the crisis, humanitarian aid, political prisoners and political dialogue.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
events.title: Lawngtlai to check illegal entries from Myanmar
events.text: A Lawngtlai District meeting led by the Additional Deputy Commissioner decided to carry out entry checks on people entering illegally from Myanmar and Bangladesh.

events.title: Food aid to displaced in six places
events.text: The Network for Chin Community Development gave food to displaced Chin people at six places in Kanpetlet and Tedim Townships and Champhai and Lunglei districts, 12 to 20 January.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram minister: refugees affect tourism
events.text: Mizoram's Tourism Minister said the state's support for refugees from Myanmar was affecting its tourism plans, according to India Today.

events.title: New town plan for Tonzang
events.text: The Tonzang Township Council chairman said a new Tonzang town plan would be carried out on about 200 acres, two years after Chinland Council forces took the town.

events.title: 50,000 in Kalay forests need food
events.text: About 50,000 people from 22 villages in the CDF-KKG area of Kalay Township were sheltering in forests and needed food and medicine.

events.title: Mizoram seizes drugs worth 196 crore rupees
events.text: Mizoram said drugs worth 196.42 crore rupees were seized and 185 people arrested from September 2025 to January 2026, according to India Today.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Central YMA opposes border fence
events.text: After meeting India's Home Ministry officials in New Delhi, the Central Young Mizo Association said it opposed the plan to fence the India-Myanmar border.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Paletwa youth flee AA recruitment to Bangladesh
events.text: Chin youths in Paletwa Township were fleeing to Bangladesh because the Arakan Army was arresting young people for a 45-day military training, according to local sources.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram asks Delhi for refugee funds
events.text: Mizoram's Home Minister said the state had asked the central government for 5 crore rupees to support refugees from Myanmar.

events.title: Chinland: 100 junta troops killed near Falam
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Defence said that in three months of fighting the junta column trying to retake Falam, about 100 junta soldiers were killed and 20 captured.

incidents.detail: Near Fawnglei village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.actors: Chinland Government-led Chin joint forces vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces fight junta column near Fawnglei
incidents.text: A junta column marching from Kalay towards Falam fought Chin joint forces led by the Chinland Government near Fawnglei village; 26 junta soldiers including a major were killed and heavy and about 20 small arms seized, according to the Chinland Ministry of Defence.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages monastery in Mindat Township
incidents.text: At about 2:20 PM a junta airstrike on a village in Circle 1, Mindat Township, damaged a Buddhist monastery and some homes.

incidents.title: Bombs damage homes in Kanpetlet
incidents.text: At about 9 AM the junta dropped two bombs on Kanpetlet town, damaging homes and a government building.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
incidents.title: CDF-Daai arrests 17 youths for military service
incidents.text: CDF-Daai (CPU/CPA) arrested 17 young people, including students, in villages of Daai area 1 to force them into military service.

incidents.title: PDF-Zoland holds 200 opium field workers
incidents.text: PDF-Zoland said it was holding about 200 labourers from opium fields in Tedim Township; it released those not aged 18 to 35 and some others and said the rest would serve in the military.

incidents.title: Bombs on Mindat hit shops, clinic, monastery
incidents.text: At about 10 AM the junta dropped two bombs on Mindat town, damaging shops, homes, a clinic and a Buddhist monastery.

incidents.detail: Chun Pyan (A) village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Bombs on Chun Pyan kill child, injure 12
incidents.text: At about 12 noon the junta dropped four bombs on Chun Pyan (A) village, killing a 13-year-old child, injuring 12 people including five students, and burning a home.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Tlangkhua kills six
incidents.text: At about 12 noon a junta airstrike on Tlangkhua village killed six civilians and injured seven.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha ambushes junta police
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha ambushed junta-backed police who had been extorting money from residents in Hakha; three were killed, five injured and two vehicles destroyed, according to the CDF-Hakha Central Council.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
incidents.title: Madu villagers protest CDF-Daai recruitment
incidents.text: Residents of Madu (Mardu) village in Daai area 3 protested after CDF-Daai entered the village to arrest young people for forced military service.

incidents.detail: Air-drop site on the Falam front
incidents.title: Chin forces seize junta air-dropped ammunition
incidents.text: Chin joint forces seized heavy ammunition (120mm and 60mm mortar shells, drone bombs, 40mm shells and RPG rounds) air-dropped for the junta column advancing on Falam, during a mine-clearing operation.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Zanphawl injures two
incidents.text: At about 8 PM a junta airstrike on Zanphawl village injured two civilians and damaged homes.

incidents.title: Junta drops 12 bombs on Lumbang
incidents.text: At about 2 AM the junta dropped 12 bombs on Lumbang village, injuring one civilian and damaging homes.

incidents.title: Airstrikes on Cinkhua and Zokhua injure four
incidents.text: At about 1 AM junta airstrikes on Cinkhua and Zokhua villages injured four civilians and damaged at least nine homes. Counted as two attacks (two villages).

incidents.title: Junta drones hit Chin National Day event in Hakha
incidents.text: As the junta's deputy commander-in-chief and 17 officials visited Hakha, the junta attacked a Chin National Day celebration in the town with drones, ending the event, according to CDF-Hakha.

incidents.title: Junta shoots civil servant dead in Hakha
incidents.text: Junta troops shot dead a Chin civil servant returning home by motorbike from work in Hakha.

incidents.title: 3.9 kg stimulant tablets seized in Lawngtlai
incidents.text: Lawngtlai District Police arrested a local man and two men from Rakhine State in Kakichhuah village with 3.852 kg of stimulant tablets.

incidents.detail: Zalai, Taal, Laikua, Tlangzar, Ramthlo and Thlanrawn villages
incidents.title: Junta drops 40 bombs on Chin National Day
incidents.text: On Chin National Day, at about 10 AM, the junta dropped 40 bombs on Zalai, Taal, Laikua, Tlangzar, Ramthlo and Thlanrawn villages; details of damage were not known. Counted as six attacks (six villages).

incidents.title: Tedim man arrested with drugs in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Champhai District Police in Zokhawthar arrested a 52-year-old man from Lamzang village, Tedim Township, with 10.259 grams of stimulant tablets and 165 grams of heroin hidden in his motorbike.

incidents.title: 15.8 kg stimulant tablets seized in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Police and Assam Rifles in Zokhawthar arrested a 29-year-old man from Satawm village, Falam Township, with 15.836 kg of stimulant tablets on his motorbike.

incidents.title: Fighting near Tuphei
incidents.text: Fighting near Tuphei village between the junta column advancing on Falam and Chin joint forces; junta casualties were reported and four weapons seized.

incidents.detail: On the way to a coffee farm
incidents.title: Landmine kills farmer from Khuangmual
incidents.text: A 57-year-old man from Khuangmual village was killed by a landmine on his way to his coffee farm.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC drone attack on PDA camp
incidents.text: The junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) attacked a People's Defense Army camp near Anlangh village with drones, and both sides exchanged fire.

incidents.detail: Former LIB 140 and LIB 304 camps, now held by the Arakan Army
incidents.title: Junta bombs AA-held camps in Matupi
incidents.text: The junta dropped six bombs on the former LIB 140 and LIB 304 camps in Matupi, now held by the Arakan Army; damage was not reported.

events.title: CNF statement on coup anniversary
events.text: On the fifth anniversary of the coup the CNF said it would keep working with the people and allied revolutionary forces to end military rule and build a federal democratic union.

issues: Opium and drug control
Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland Parliament passes drug law
events.text: At the first regular session of its second term, 2-3 February in Chinlung, the Chinland Parliament enacted the Chinland Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Law 2026 and the Chinland Tax Law 2026.

events.title: Timor-Leste prosecutor seeks junta arrest warrants
events.text: CHRO and the Myanmar Accountability Project said the Timor-Leste prosecutor had requested arrest warrants for Min Aung Hlaing and ten other generals over their case.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram papers: few drug arrests are refugees
events.text: Mizoram newspapers said that Myanmar nationals made up only 2.9 percent of drug arrests in the state over six years, rejecting claims that refugees are driving crime.

events.title: Chinland honours CDM health staff
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Health and Sports honoured all health staff who joined the Civil Disobedience Movement against the 2021 coup.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram CM: cannot stop border fence
events.text: Mizoram's Chief Minister told state ministers that border fencing is a central government project and the state has no power to stop it.

events.title: CNF message on Karen Revolution Day
events.text: The CNF sent a message on the 75th Karen Revolution Day pledging to work with Karen allies towards a federal democratic union.

events.title: Senthang bars youth from leaving without letter
events.text: The Senthang Central Council said people aged 15 to 35 may not leave its area without a recommendation letter, and those who must leave need one from its defence and home affairs departments.

events.title: New Chinland cabinet holds first meeting
events.text: After the Chinland Council reorganised the government into six ministries, the first cabinet meeting under the Prime Minister was held in Chinlung on 6-7 February, covering seven areas including defence, land disputes, a monitoring committee, politics and humanitarian aid.

events.title: HPO stops land sales in Rihkhawdar
events.text: While a town plan for Rihkhawdar is being drafted, the Hualngoram People's Organization told residents of wards 1 and 2 not to sell plots of land.

events.others: Tonzang Township Council; Thado Defense Army (TDA)
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Tonzang council objects to Thado Defense Army rule
events.text: The Tonzang Township Council said it strongly objected to the Thado Defense Army setting up its own administration in villages of the Reilthawphai area.

events.title: Chinland: 200 junta troops killed near Falam
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Defence said that in four months of fighting the junta column advancing on Falam, about 200 junta soldiers including nine officers were killed and weapons and supplies seized.

events.title: CDF-Hakha warns people out of forests
events.text: CDF-Hakha warned civilians not to go into the forests near Hakha from 9 February until further notice.

events.title: Lautu gives farmers free seed and loans
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration said it would give farmers free seed, interest-free loans and technical help.

events.title: Ministers visit Tlangkhua airstrike victims
events.text: Chinland Government ministers visited people from Tlangkhua village being treated at Chinlung hospital after the junta airstrike and gave them support.

events.title: Maraland council seeks stronger AA alliance
events.text: The Maraland Administrative Council recalled its September 2025 meeting with the ULA/AA commander-in-chief and said it would build a stronger alliance with the AA.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland Council appoints second-term bodies
events.text: The Chinland Council said it had appointed the Chinland Parliament, Government, Supreme Court and Auditor-General for its second term.

events.title: Chinland Government hires finance staff
events.text: The Chinland Government invited applications for nine posts in its planning, finance and audit departments to strengthen public finance management.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram registers 26,381 refugees
events.text: Mizoram's Home Department said biometric data had been collected for 26,381 of 28,355 refugees from Myanmar in the state.

events.title: CNF marks Panglong anniversary
events.text: On the 79th anniversary of the Panglong Agreement the CNF said it would work with allies to build a federal democratic union based on the bottom-up federal principle.

events.type: Meeting or agreement between border authorities
events.title: Chinland meets ICFAI University
events.text: Chinland Council and Government ministers met a team from ICFAI University, Mizoram, led by its Vice Chancellor, in Chinlung to discuss further study for students from Chinland.

events.type: Road or trade route closed or reopened
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Lawngtlai closes border trade after trader's death
events.text: After a Mizo trader from Lawngtlai died in Rinlatwa village, Paletwa Township, held by the Arakan Army, Lawngtlai District closed all border trade routes on 16 February and reopened them on 25 February.

events.others: Chin National University; Myanmar Spring University
events.title: Chin National University opens law course
events.text: Chin National University and Myanmar Spring University jointly opened an LLB law course, with an online and in-person ceremony.

events.title: Chinland defence spending to rise to 80%
events.text: A Chinland Council vice chairman told Khonumthung Media that defence spending would rise from 65 percent to 80 percent of the Chinland Government budget this year.

events.title: Chinland Council and NLD hold first meeting
events.text: The Chinland Council and Government and the NLD Central Working Committee held their first meeting online on working together.

events.title: Lautu sets fire safety rules
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration set fire safety rules: no clearing fires near homes or buildings, and burning only in safe, marked areas.

events.title: Chinland Council marks Chin National Day
events.text: On the 78th Chin National Day the Chinland Council Chairman urged Chin people not to leave Chinland and to join in rebuilding it; leaders of the NUG, CRPH, KIO, KNU and KNPP attended the celebration.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CNF honours the fallen on Chin National Day
events.text: On Chin National Day the CNF paid tribute to fallen fighters and civilians and said unity is needed to free Chinland.

events.title: Fire destroys ten homes in Twi Kin Wa
events.text: Ten homes in Twi Kin Wa village, Paletwa Township, burned down in a fire caused by cooking.

events.title: Forest fire burns home in Sihhmuh
events.text: A home in Sihhmuh village, Thantlang Township, burned down when a forest fire spread.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Tonzang orders military service for youth
events.text: Under a Defence Coordination Team decision, the Tonzang Township Council said men aged 16 to 35 and women aged 16 to 25 in the township will do military service.

events.others: Kanpetlet Township People's Administration; Thantlang council; Mindat Township People's Administration
events.title: Kanpetlet sets dry-season fire rules
events.text: The Kanpetlet Township People's Administration set fire prevention rules for the dry season, with fines for those who do not comply; the Thantlang council and Mindat administration did the same on 26 and 27 February.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: CDF-Matupi orders deserters to return
events.text: CDF-Matupi called on members who left without permission to return to duty by a set date or be treated as deserters.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.title: Chinland leaders visit Hualngoram and Ngawn
events.text: Chinland Council and Government leaders visited the Hualngoram and Ngawn areas of Falam Township in the fourth week of February, meeting local administrations and residents.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages four homes in Lumbang
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Lumbang (Lungbang) village damaged four homes.

incidents.title: 5.9 kg of meth seized in Mizoram
incidents.text: Mizoram Police arrested two Myanmar nationals and a local man with 5.935 kg of methamphetamine tablets and five packets of heroin.

incidents.title: Chin forces seize junta air drop near Lungbang
incidents.text: Chin resistance forces intercepted a junta Y-12 aircraft supply drop near Lungbang and Varllon villages, seizing nine 60mm mortar shells and food.

incidents.title: Clash near Hlanzawl, four killed
incidents.text: A clash near Hlanzawl village killed three junta soldiers, including an officer, and one Chin resistance fighter.

incidents.detail: Route between Taingen and Zawngkawng villages, 4-19 March
incidents.title: CDF-CDM Siyin mines junta column for 15 days
incidents.text: Over 15 days CDF-CDM Siyin carried out repeated landmine attacks on a junta reinforcement column of more than 200 troops from Kalay, between Taingen and Zawngkawng; about 50 soldiers, including a colonel, were reported killed.

incidents.title: Junta burns Hlanzawl village
incidents.text: Junta troops deliberately burned Hlanzawl village; the extent of damage could not be confirmed because access was restricted.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha kills two junta police
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha targeted junta police officers who had been extorting money from civilians in Hakha; two were killed and one wounded.

incidents.title: Drone bomb kills young woman in Lunghawh
incidents.text: A junta drone bomb attack on Lunghawh village killed a 19-year-old woman and seriously injured her mother.

incidents.title: Body found buried in Tuphei
incidents.text: Residents of Tuphei village found and cremated the body of an unidentified man buried in front of a house; junta troops are believed responsible.

incidents.title: Junta shells and drones Lungbang and Parte
incidents.text: Combined artillery and drone bomb attacks on Lungbang and Parte villages damaged one house. Counted as two attacks (two villages).

incidents.detail: Former LIB-304 camp and nearby areas, 11-13 March
incidents.title: Junta bombs near old LIB-304 camp in Matupi
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes hit the area around the former LIB-304 camp near Matupi town between 11 and 13 March, with four bombs in total. Counted as one attack because the briefing gives only the bomb total.

incidents.title: Drone attack kills man in Simzawl
incidents.text: A junta drone attack on Simzawl village killed a 56-year-old man and destroyed his house.

incidents.title: Chin forces attack junta collecting air drops
incidents.text: Chin resistance forces attacked junta troops collecting air-dropped rations in Falam Township, killing one soldier and wounding three.

incidents.title: Unexploded bomb kills child in Ramthlo
incidents.text: Unexploded ordnance found by children in Ramthlo village went off when handled, killing one child and injuring another.

incidents.detail: Near the Vaar bridge camp area
incidents.title: Airstrikes damage homes near Vaar bridge
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes near the Vaar bridge camp area damaged several homes.

incidents.title: Airstrikes on Lunghawh kill three
incidents.text: Airstrikes on Lunghawh village killed three civilians, including a child, and damaged four houses.

incidents.title: Eight Chin fighters killed in Falam fighting
incidents.text: Eight fighters of the CNF-led joint forces were killed in the second week of sustained fighting in Falam Township.

incidents.title: Two bombs on Daidin, no casualties
incidents.text: Two bombs were dropped on Daidin village; no casualties were reported.

incidents.title: Three bombs on Matupi town
incidents.text: Three bombs were dropped on Matupi town; damage could not be confirmed.

incidents.detail: Chin State Parliament building and government offices
incidents.title: CDF-Hakha drones hit junta meeting in Hakha
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha used suicide drones to attack the Chin State Parliament building and government offices in Hakha during a junta meeting.

incidents.title: Junta kills three men near Hakha college
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha condemned the junta for killing three men near Hakha Technology College and posing their bodies with rifles for propaganda.

incidents.title: Airstrikes destroy 14 homes in Zawngkawng
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes on Zawngkawng village destroyed 14 homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Kyaung Chaung kills seven, four children
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes on Kyaung Chaung village killed seven civilians, including four children, and injured four: the deadliest strike of the month.

incidents.detail: Near Mualpi village, on the way to road repairs
incidents.title: Landmine kills woman near Mualpi
incidents.text: A 26-year-old woman was killed by a landmine near Mualpi village while going to help with road repairs.

incidents.title: CDF-CDM Siyin captures junta deserter
incidents.text: CDF-CDM Siyin captured a junta soldier who had deserted his post near Zawngkawng.

incidents.title: Airstrike destroys office in Mindat
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes destroyed the Rural Development office in Mindat; civilian casualties were reported but not confirmed.

events.title: Thantlang bans hunting in breeding season
events.text: The Thantlang Peng Council temporarily banned hunting or catching birds and animals in its area during the breeding season.

events.title: Mizoram warns displaced against crime
events.text: Mizoram's Home Minister warned displaced people living in the state against involvement in illegal activities.

events.title: Lautu requires vehicle registration
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration required vehicle owners in the Lautu region, and outside owners bringing goods in, to register at its office; it also set rules on temporary household registration and visitor reporting.

events.title: Zotung repairs Rezua-Gangaw road
events.text: The Zotung Regional Council's construction department began repairing the Rezua-Gangaw road with the Chinland Government, using two machines at an estimated 180 million kyats.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Lawngtlai and Aizawl ban Myanmar ginger
events.text: District administrations in Lawngtlai and Aizawl banned the illegal import, trade and storage of ginger from Myanmar (5-9 March).

events.title: Matupi man arrested with 19 air guns
events.text: Assam Rifles and police arrested a man from Matupi in Siaha District with 19 air guns and related items.

events.detail: Displacement camps in Chinland and Sagaing
events.title: Displaced women need medicine, says Women for Justice
events.text: Women for Justice said displacement camps in Chinland and Sagaing urgently need medicine and supplies for women, including vitamins, contraceptives and hygiene products.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: NUG requires permits for fuel to Chinland
events.text: The NUG instructed allied organisations to get prior permission to move fuel through NUG-run areas when it is bound for Chinland, Kachin or Rakhine.

events.title: Lautu bans gambling
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration banned gambling in the Lautu region.

events.detail: Joint tax gates in Hakha Township and the Zotung region
events.title: Chinland PM inspects tax gates
events.text: The Chinland Government Prime Minister and cabinet members inspected joint tax collection gates in Hakha Township and the Zotung region from 10 to 12 March.

issues: Opium and drug control
events.title: Tonzang village youth ban opium
events.text: The Tonzang village youth group in Tedim Township banned opium cultivation in its area and warned of strict action.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: CDF-KKG holds second conference
events.text: CDF-Kalay-Kabaw-Gangaw held its Second General Conference from 11 to 13 March, reporting 92 members killed in the revolution and calling on all adults in its area to do military service.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Mizoram CM: must engage AA on Kaladan
events.text: Mizoram's Chief Minister said the state must engage the Arakan Army on the Kaladan project because the AA now controls Paletwa Township.

events.title: CDF-Hakha apologises for beating youths
events.text: CDF-Hakha publicly apologised to 16 youths after confirming its members had beaten them at a checkpoint on 7 March.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Chinland Council sets three-year military service
events.text: The Chinland Council announced a minimum three-year military service policy so that areas taken from the junta are not lost again.

events.title: CNF backs CRPH session
events.text: The CNF sent a message of support to the CRPH for holding its ninth parliamentary session.

events.title: Mizoram plans railway to border
events.text: Mizoram's Governor said there are plans to extend the Mizoram railway to the border to link with the Kaladan project.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Chinland Council drafts trade law
events.text: The first draft-law committee meeting of the Chinland Council's second term, in Chinlung, discussed the Chinland Export and Import Draft Law. The Council also set public holidays under the Chinland Constitution (2023).

events.title: CNF frees 30 prisoners of war
events.text: The CNF granted amnesty to 30 prisoners of war.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Siaha bans fuel export to Myanmar
events.text: Siaha District imposed a two-month ban on the illegal export of fuel to Myanmar to prevent local shortages.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: CNF calls adults to serve on Revolution Day
events.text: On the 38th Chin Revolution Day the CNF called on Chin adults to serve the revolution and warned against the junta's planned election.

events.title: CHRO condemns junta appointments to Chin parliament
events.text: CHRO condemned the appointment of two junta officers accused of human rights violations as military representatives in the Chin State Parliament.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: ICNCC/CB promises unity after junta is gone
events.text: The ICNCC/CB Chairman said Chin armed groups would work towards unity once the junta is driven out, calling the Falam battle a shared struggle.

issues: Opium and drug control
events.title: Valvum village bans opium
events.text: A village meeting in Valvum banned opium cultivation; violators face expulsion and confiscation of property.

events.detail: Displacement camps at the India-Myanmar border, Paletwa region
events.title: Chinland officials visit Paletwa border camps
events.text: Chinland Council and Government officials visited displacement camps on the border in the Paletwa region from 23 to 26 March, delivering aid and discussing education and health care.

actors: Chinland Govt: Ministry of Home Affairs
events.others: Chinland People's Police; local police forces
issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland police meet local police forces
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Home Affairs held the first coordination meeting between the Chinland People's Police and local police forces on public security and the rule of law.

events.others: Chin Center for Peace and Reconciliation (CCPR)
events.title: CCPR gives rice to 7,277 displaced
events.text: CCPR reported distributing 2,426 bags of rice to 7,277 displaced people in five townships between October 2025 and March 2026.

issues: Opium and drug control
events.title: CNDF condemns opium growing in Falam
events.text: The CNO/CNDF condemned opium cultivation in Falam Township and warned of prison or fines.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.title: CNF, KIO, KNU, KNPP, NUG form SCEF
events.text: The Steering Council for the Emergence of a Federal Democratic Union (SCEF) was formed by the CNF, KIO, KNU, KNPP, NUG and CRPH to coordinate the revolution and the transition to a federal democratic union.

events.type: Meeting or agreement between border authorities
events.title: Chinland officials meet MZP and ZORO
events.text: Chinland Council and Government officials met the MZP and ZORO in Aizawl on aid for displaced people and university access for displaced students in Mizoram.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Fuel shortages across Chinland
events.text: Fuel shortages worsened across Chinland, with petrol above 40,000 kyats a gallon in some areas.

events.detail: 30 villages in Falam and Tedim Townships
events.title: 3,000 displaced in Falam and Tedim short of food
events.text: More than 3,000 people from 30 villages in Falam and Tedim Townships had been displaced for over four months, short of food, shelter, sanitary supplies and medicine, with little aid access.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Farm prices fall in northern and central Chinland
events.text: Demand for avocado and grapes from northern Chinland fell sharply; ginger and chilli farmers in central Chinland were hit by Mizoram's crackdown on cross-border trade; southern farmers sold crops cheaply because of checkpoints and levies on routes to Magway.

incidents.title: Four arrested with 1.9 kg heroin at Khankawn
incidents.text: Police at Khankawn checkpoint arrested four men, residents of the district and Kalay, with 1.86 kg of heroin in a vehicle.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
incidents.title: Mara Defense Force takes 100 youths at football match
incidents.text: The Mara Defense Force (Chin Brotherhood) arrested more than 100 young people at a football match in Rakhaw village, Mara area, for military service.

incidents.title: Chin forces capture two junta deserters
incidents.text: Chin joint forces captured two junta soldiers who had fled the junta camp at Lumbang village, according to front-line sources.

incidents.title: Tonzang woman arrested with heroin in Aizawl
incidents.text: Police in Aizawl arrested a 33-year-old woman from Tonzang Township with 61 grams of heroin.

incidents.detail: Falkland ward, Aizawl, and Khawmawi village on the border
incidents.title: 10 kg of stimulant tablets seized in Aizawl
incidents.text: The Excise and Narcotics Department arrested one Myanmar national and two local people with more than 10 kg of stimulant tablets in Aizawl and Khawmawi village.

incidents.title: Three jets bomb Mindat with incendiaries, one killed
incidents.text: At about 10 PM three junta jets dropped eight bombs including incendiary bombs on parts of Mindat town, killing one civilian, injuring ten, and damaging a Buddhist association building, an office and 18 homes. Counted as one attack.

incidents.title: Bombs destroy school and homes in Tlangkhan
incidents.text: The junta dropped two bombs on Tlangkhan village, destroying a school, staff housing and at least 10 homes.

incidents.actors: Chinland Government and Chin Brotherhood forces vs junta
incidents.title: Chin forces capture junta camp near Khuangli
incidents.text: Chinland Government and Chin Brotherhood forces captured the junta camp near Khuangli village; about 20 soldiers were killed and 24 small arms, ammunition and supplies seized.

incidents.detail: Between Khawhri and Thingsai villages, near the border
incidents.title: 189 g heroin seized near Khawhri
incidents.text: Authorities seized 189 grams of heroin owned by a resident of Ralpel village, Chin State, from a local carrier between Khawhri and Thingsai villages near the border.

incidents.detail: Near Varr bridge and Khuangli village
incidents.title: Junta offensive near Varr bridge and Khuangli
incidents.text: The junta launched a heavy offensive near Varr bridge and Khuangli village with ground troops, jet fighters and Y-12 aircraft, dropping about 100 bombs.

incidents.detail: Near Varr bridge and Khuangli village
incidents.title: Jets and Y-12 drop about 100 bombs near Khuangli
incidents.text: Junta jet fighters and Y-12 aircraft dropped about 100 bombs near Varr bridge and Khuangli village in support of the ground offensive. Recorded as one airstrike on a fighting area.

incidents.detail: Near Falam town and Surbung airfield
incidents.title: Heavy fighting at Falam and Surbung airfield
incidents.text: Heavy fighting all day near Falam town and Surbung airfield; the junta used six jet fighters and Y-12 aircraft for heavy airstrikes.

incidents.detail: Near Falam town and Surbung airfield
incidents.title: Six jets and Y-12 bomb fighting at Falam and Surbung
incidents.text: Six junta jet fighters and Y-12 aircraft carried out heavy airstrikes on the fighting near Falam town and Surbung airfield. Recorded as one airstrike on a fighting area.

incidents.title: Junta column shoots Sunthla villagers, one killed
incidents.text: A junta column on the Hakha-Falam road shot at civilians from Sunthla village, killing a 32-year-old man and injuring a student.

incidents.detail: Kan Gyi village, mile 12 on the Rakhine-Chin-Magway road
incidents.title: Junta troops close trade road at Kan Gyi
incidents.text: About 200 junta troops from LIB 347 entered Kan Gyi village at mile 12 on the Rakhine-Chin-Magway trade road and set up camp, closing all routes.

incidents.title: Chin forces withdraw from Falam town
incidents.text: Under heavy ground and air attack, Chin joint forces withdrew from Falam town and Surbung airfield, according to the Chinland Ministry of Defence. It said about 500 junta soldiers were killed in some 109 clashes over six months of fighting for Falam.

incidents.detail: Thanhniar Khuathar village, mile 7 from Falam (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Junta soldiers kill elderly man near Falam
incidents.text: Junta soldiers tortured and killed a 70-year-old man in his home in Thanhniar Khuathar village, seven miles from Falam, according to villagers.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Kyin Dway kills nine road workers
incidents.text: At about 10 AM a junta airstrike on Kyin Dway town killed nine civilians, including a woman, who were repairing the market road and injured four; public machinery was destroyed, according to CPU/CPA.

incidents.detail: Khuaimual village near the India border
incidents.title: Junta bombs Khuaimual three times
incidents.text: At about 7 AM, with no fighting nearby, the junta bombed Khuaimual village three times, damaging some homes. Counted as three attacks.

actors: Chinland Govt: Ministry of Home Affairs
events.title: Chinland Home Ministry hires senior staff
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Home Affairs invited applications for two senior posts to strengthen its work.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland justice officials meet Hakha council
events.text: In late March to 1 April the Chinland Government Home Minister, Chief Justice and Attorney General met the CDF-Hakha Central Council and Senthang Central Council to explain Chinland policies and laws and improve coordination.

events.title: Lautu hands over 20 guns bought with donations
events.text: The Lautu people affairs council held a handover of 20 small arms, bought with public donations under 'The 20 Project' since October 2025, to CDF-Lautu.

events.title: Lunglei police seize diesel bound for Rakhine
events.text: Lunglei District Police seized about 1,900 gallons of diesel meant to be smuggled into Rakhine State, with two vehicles.

issues: Junta election and boycott
events.title: Zomi National Party congratulates Min Aung Hlaing
events.text: The Zomi National Party, which won seven seats in Chinland in the junta's 2025 election, congratulated Min Aung Hlaing on his election as president.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CDF-Thantlang marks fifth anniversary
events.text: On its fifth anniversary the Thantlang Peng Council/CDF-Thantlang said it would keep working with allies and strive for Chin unity.

events.detail: Bridge between Ngalang village and Ainak, Mizoram
events.title: Ngalang-Ainak border bridge begins
events.text: Construction began on a border bridge for motor vehicles and goods between Ngalang village (Thantlang) and Ainak village in Mizoram.

events.title: Junta revokes Khonumthung and Chin World licences
events.text: The junta's information ministry revoked the media licences of Khonumthung Media Group and Chin World from 8 April 2026.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Mara council orders military service for adults
events.text: Because junta and other armed groups threaten the Mara area, MTC/MDF (Chin Brotherhood) said all Mara adults must do military service.

events.title: HPO bans improper hunting
events.text: The Hualngoram People's Organization's administration banned hunting wild animals by improper methods from April to August, with fines of up to 1 million kyats.

events.title: Chin Brotherhood pledges to stand with AA
events.text: On the ULA/AA's 17th anniversary the Chin Brotherhood said it would stand with the Arakan Army until the end of military rule.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: AA deputy chief speaks at ICNCC anniversary
