events.text: At the ICNCC's fifth anniversary, the ULA/AA deputy chairman said Chin organisations were strong politically but weak militarily, and urged them to build strong forces.

events.title: HPO supports families of fallen fighters
events.text: HPO/CDF-Hualngoram said it is giving regular support to families of fallen fighters, disabled fighters and serving members, with local residents.

events.title: CNDF marks fifth anniversary
events.text: On its fifth anniversary CNO/CNDF said it would keep fighting with ICNCC/CB allies for a federal union with self-determination and a Chinland built by Chin people.

events.title: Chinland Council meets NUG Prime Minister
events.text: The Chinland Council and Government met the NUG Prime Minister in Chinlung on cooperation, the Council's three pillars of work and the NUG's work.

events.title: Lautu repairs village roads
events.text: The Lautu Region People's Administration said its transport department had started repairing village roads in the region.

events.detail: Falam and Tedim Townships, the border, Kalay and Tamu
events.title: Institute of Chin Affairs gives aid
events.text: The Institute of Chin Affairs said that in the first three months of 2026 it gave about 2 million rupees of food and hygiene supplies to some 10,000 displaced Chin people in Falam and Tedim Townships, on the border, and in Kalay and Tamu.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Justice workshop in Zophei region
events.text: The Chinland Government, Attorney General and Zophei Federal Council held a justice workshop in the Zophei region on building a trusted justice system and coordination between Chinland and local courts.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Refugees in Mizoram to be counted in census
events.text: Indian census officials said in Aizawl that refugees in Mizoram will be included in India's census.

events.title: Chinland opens Jordan School of Medicine
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Health opened the Chinland Jordan School of Medicine with its first intake; the NUG Prime Minister attended, spoke and gave funds.

events.title: CDF-Zophei marks fifth anniversary
events.text: On its fifth anniversary CDF-Zophei said it would keep fighting for self-determination and continue to bar junta-linked people from property and travel in the Zophei area.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.detail: Matupi Council and Zotung Federal Council areas
events.title: Chinland PM visits Matupi and Zotung
events.text: A Chinland Government team led by the Prime Minister visited the Matupi Council and Zotung Federal Council areas, 16-19 April, on administration, education, health and humanitarian aid.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: First Matupi Council congress
events.text: The first Matupi Council congress, with 112 representatives, amended and approved the Matupi Council law and formed local administration bodies, 17-18 April.

events.title: CDF-Hualngoram recruits youth
events.text: CDF-Hualngoram invited young people to join its basic training and defend Chinland.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: ZPCC/ZRA-EC warns others out of Tedim and Tonzang
events.text: The junta-allied ZPCC/ZRA-EC warned other armed and political groups not to operate or govern in Tedim and Tonzang Townships (Zogam) without its permission.

actors: Chinland Govt: Ministry of Home Affairs
issues: Opium and drug control
Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Local administration workshop in Aizawl
events.text: The Chinland Home Minister, Attorney General and 14 local administrations held a workshop in Aizawl on local administration law, the narcotics law and registration of organisations.

events.title: CPU/CPA met AA leaders in Rakhine
events.text: CPU/CPA said that in February 2026 it met ULA/AA leaders in Rakhine State on the revolution, relations between Chin and Arakan people and future cooperation.

events.title: Chinland education workshop on curriculum
events.text: In late March the Chinland Ministry of Education held a workshop with township education heads, teachers and CDM lecturers on drafting a Chinland basic and higher education policy.

events.title: Tedim residents leave amid attack rumours
events.text: With rumours that resistance forces would attack Tedim town, residents began moving to nearby villages and to Mizoram.

events.title: CNF rejects return to NCA
events.text: The CNF spokesperson said it would not accept Min Aung Hlaing's call for groups to return to the NCA, and would keep to SCEF's policy and goals.

events.others: CPU/CPA; Interim Khumi Affairs Consultative Council (IKACC)
events.title: IKACC and CPU/CPA meet on border disputes
events.text: The IKACC said it held its first formal meeting with CPU/CPA in Matupi in late March, with useful talks on border disputes between their areas and on cooperation.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: ICNCC forms eight departments
events.text: The ICNCC formed eight departments, including administration, defence, public affairs, the Chinland People's Police, justice and finance, to run administration in its areas.

events.title: SCEF welcomes Suu Kyi's family return
events.text: SCEF, which includes the CNF, welcomed the return of Daw Aung San Suu Kyi's family and said it would work for the release of all political prisoners.

incidents.title: Bombs on Khuapisip kill seven, three children
incidents.text: At about 3:20 PM the junta dropped two 500-pound bombs on Khuapisip (Khawpichip) village, killing seven civilians including three children, wounding nine and damaging over 10 homes.

incidents.title: Drone bomb kills girl near Thlanrawn
incidents.text: A junta drone bomb hit civilians sheltering in farm huts near Thlanrawn village, killing a 17-year-old girl from Arva village.

incidents.detail: Fuel station at the town entrance
incidents.title: Shell kills 13-year-old at Tedim fuel station
incidents.text: A 13-year-old was killed when an artillery shell fired by LIB 269 in Tedim town exploded at a fuel station at the town entrance.

incidents.detail: Near Leithingkung (not matched in MIMU), 2-4 May
incidents.title: Chin Brotherhood fights junta near Leithingkung
incidents.text: Heavy fighting near Leithingkung between Chin Brotherhood forces and a junta column marching from Kalay to reinforce Tedim town, with casualties on both sides.

incidents.detail: Kennedy Peak outpost near Tedim town
incidents.title: Junta retakes Kennedy Peak
incidents.text: On 5-6 May the junta retook the Kennedy Peak outpost near Tedim town with superior ground and air forces; Chin Brotherhood forces withdrew.

incidents.title: CDF-CDM Siyin mines junta convoy
incidents.text: CDF-CDM Siyin ambushed a junta supply convoy from Kalay with landmines near Hiangzing (Heinzin) village, causing 13 junta casualties and seizing three small arms.

incidents.title: Drone bombs on Phunom kill three
incidents.text: At about 4 PM the junta dropped three drone bombs on Phunom village, killing three civilians, injuring one and destroying an Assemblies of God church.

incidents.title: CNA fights junta column on Falam-Hakha road
incidents.text: The CNA fought a junta column of about 300 advancing from Falam town on the Falam-Hakha highway; 15 junta soldiers were killed.

incidents.title: Jet bombs Mindat offices
incidents.text: At about 7 AM a junta jet dropped four bombs on Mindat town, damaging the immigration and national registration office and the fire station.

incidents.title: 600 junta troops reach Tedim
incidents.text: A junta column of about 600 from Kalay reached Light Infantry Battalion 269 in Tedim town as reinforcements, according to local sources.

incidents.title: Nine airstrikes on Mindat kill four
incidents.text: Nine junta airstrikes on three locations in Mindat town on 11-12 May killed four people, including prisoners of war, wounded several and destroyed 15 homes, 10 government buildings and 4 vehicles. Counted as nine attacks, as reported.

incidents.title: 10.8 kg stimulant tablets seized in Champhai
incidents.text: Champhai District Police arrested a man from Chinland with over 10.8 kg of stimulant tablets and 75 grams of heroin.

incidents.actors: Junta and ZRA-EC vs Chin resistance forces
incidents.title: Junta and ZRA attack Tonzang
incidents.text: Heavy fighting near Tonzang town as a joint column of over 800 junta and ZRA (Eastern Command) troops tried to retake the town.

incidents.detail: Towns in Mindat, Kanpetlet and Matupi Townships, 13-22 May
incidents.title: 25 aerial bombings on southern towns
incidents.text: Over 10 days the junta carried out 25 aerial bombings on towns in Mindat, Kanpetlet and Matupi Townships, killing two civilians including a newborn, injuring several and destroying homes, shops and government offices. Counted as 25 attacks, as reported; the briefing does not split them by township, so they are placed in Mindat Township.

incidents.title: Hakha council detains Pyu Saw Htee member
incidents.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council detained a member of the junta-backed Pyu Saw Htee militia in Hakha town for extortion and threats.

incidents.title: CNA ambushes junta commander's column in Hakha
incidents.text: A CNA-led force ambushed a junta column carrying the LIB 266 commanding officer near the six-way junction in Hakha; four junta soldiers were killed and many, including the commander, wounded.

incidents.title: Two airstrikes on Lungzan
incidents.text: At about 5:30 PM the junta carried out two aerial bombings on Lungzan village; casualties and damage could not be verified. Counted as two attacks.

incidents.detail: Tedim-Tonzang road, Cikha-Tonzang road and village roads
incidents.title: Junta and ZRA three-pronged attack on Tonzang
incidents.text: Junta and ZRA forces launched a three-pronged offensive on Tonzang along the Tedim-Tonzang and Cikha-Tonzang roads and village roads.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Tonzang town
incidents.text: The junta carried out an airstrike on Tonzang town in the afternoon, during fighting for the town; no details were given.

incidents.actors: Central Anti-Drug Squad and Central Young Mizo Association
incidents.title: Myanmar man arrested with heroin in Aizawl
incidents.text: The Central Anti-Drug Squad and Central Young Mizo Association arrested a Myanmar national in Aizawl with 20 packets of heroin.

incidents.detail: Between Tonzang town and Tungtuang village
incidents.actors: Chinland Council forces vs junta and ZRA-EC
incidents.title: Fierce fighting near Tonzang
incidents.text: Fierce fighting between Chinland Council forces and the junta-ZRA column between Tonzang town and Tungtuang village.

incidents.actors: Junta and ZRA-EC vs Chinland Council forces
incidents.title: Chinland forces withdraw from Tonzang
incidents.text: After sustained air and artillery bombardment, junta and ZRA forces gained control and Chinland Council troops withdrew from Tonzang town.

incidents.title: Tedim man arrested with heroin in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Police in Zokhawthar arrested a man from Tedim Township with three soap cases of heroin.

incidents.title: Five days of fighting near Kanpetlet
incidents.text: Five days of heavy fighting at mile 6 near Kanpetlet town between Chin resistance forces and a junta column advancing from Saw Township.

incidents.title: Falam woman arrested with 1.7 kg heroin
incidents.text: Police in Zokhawthar arrested a woman from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 1.66 kg of heroin.

incidents.title: 9.5 kg stimulant tablets seized in Champhai
incidents.text: Champhai District Police stopped a vehicle and arrested two residents and a Myanmar national with 9.5 kg of stimulant tablets.

events.detail: 10 sites in Chin State, Sagaing and Mizoram
events.title: Food aid to displaced at 10 sites
events.text: The Network for Chin Community Development gave food to displaced Chin people at 10 sites in Chin State, Sagaing Region and Mizoram (4-17 May).

events.title: Weapons found near border in Champhai
events.text: Assam Rifles found a 60mm mortar tube, mortar shells, grenades, radios and IEDs hidden in a forest near the border in Champhai District.

events.title: 820 from Falam flee to Zokhawthar
events.text: After the junta retook Falam and with rumours of an attack on Rihkhawdar, over 820 displaced people from Falam Township crossed into Zokhawthar, Mizoram.

events.title: Maraland bans chemical pesticides
events.text: The Maraland Administrative Council banned chemical pesticides, herbicides and similar toxic substances in Maraland, citing risks to health, soil, water, livestock and the environment.

events.title: CNDF and CDF-Thantlang graduate trainees
events.text: The CNDF and CDF-Thantlang held graduation ceremonies for military trainees and reserve forces.

events.title: NCB arrests Mizoram drug coordinator in Delhi
events.text: The Narcotics Control Bureau arrested in New Delhi a man it described as a major coordinator of drug trafficking from Myanmar into Mizoram, Manipur, Assam and Tripura. In May Mizoram law enforcement arrested five people from Chinland, seizing about 12.07 kg of heroin and 20.318 kg of other drugs.

events.type: Public consultation or meeting with the public
events.detail: Lautu, Mara, Thantlang and Zophei regions
events.title: Chinland ministers visit southern regions
events.text: Chinland Government ministers visited the Lautu, Mara, Thantlang and Zophei regions from 18 to 22 May, meeting local officials and residents on health, education and humanitarian services.

events.title: CPU appeals to diaspora for defence funds
events.text: The Chin People's Union appealed to Chin diaspora communities for defence funding as the junta prepared offensives in southern Chin State; on 25 May it asked for tens of billions of kyats for counter-offensives in southern Chinland and the Yaw region.

events.title: CDF-Hualngoram limits travel hours
events.text: Citing security operations, CDF-Hualngoram restricted travel hours on the Laitui-Rihkhawdar highway.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Lawngtlai controls fuel sales
events.text: The Lawngtlai Deputy Commissioner's office issued strict controls on illegal fuel sales and smuggling into Myanmar.

events.title: Senthang requires travel letters, bomb shelters
events.text: Fearing junta infiltration, the Senthang Central Council required travel recommendation letters and urged residents to prepare bomb shelters and stock supplies.

events.others: Chin State Level Education CDM Organization
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CDM teachers form Chin education body
events.text: CDM education staff formed the Chin State Level Education CDM Organization to run community schools and promote unity in revolutionary education.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Hakha council arrests own secretary over killing
events.text: The CDF-Hakha Central Council arrested its General Secretary over the 15 May killing of its former Vice Secretary and formed an investigation committee that includes the Chinland Ministry of Defence.

events.title: Mindat and Kanpetlet restrict movement
events.text: Because of rising theft during junta offensives, the Mindat and Kanpetlet administrations restricted movement, banned public gatherings and imposed night curfews (27-30 May).

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Junta blockade causes shortages
events.text: The junta blockaded trade routes into Chinland, causing acute shortages of essential goods and high inflation.

events.title: CHRO files second Timor-Leste case
events.text: CHRO filed a lawsuit against junta leaders and officers over civilian harm in a court of first instance in Timor-Leste.

incidents.detail: Mindat town and its eastern edge, near the Yaw front, 1-30 June
incidents.title: 317 air attacks on Mindat in June
incidents.text: The junta carried out 317 air attacks with about 836 bombs on Mindat town and the fighting areas on its eastern edge, including targeted attacks on civilian homes and public buildings. The text gives the dates as 1 to 30 May, but the June summary counts these attacks in June. Recorded as 317 attacks on mixed targets.

incidents.detail: Between Mon Taung and Shwe Phyu villages, southern Kalay Township
incidents.title: CDF-KKG fights junta in southern Kalay
incidents.text: Fighting between CDF-KKG (Chinland Government) and junta troops in southern Kalay Township; one junta soldier was killed and a small arm seized.

incidents.detail: Eastern edge of Kanpetlet town, 1-30 June
incidents.title: 37 air attacks on Kanpetlet in June
incidents.text: The junta carried out at least 37 air attacks with about 76 bombs on the eastern edge of Kanpetlet town, where fighting was taking place. Dated as in the Mindat entry above. Recorded as 37 attacks on mixed targets.

incidents.detail: Three villages including Thayakan and Kyauk Pa Lin
incidents.actors: Khumi National Congress Party/Khumi People Front
issues: Military service and forced recruitment
incidents.title: Khumi group forcibly takes 50 youths
incidents.text: The Khumi National Congress Party/Khumi People Front, formed in Paletwa in 2025, forcibly took about 50 young people, including women, from three villages for military service.

incidents.title: Unknown group attacks CDF-Hualngoram
incidents.text: An unknown armed group attacked CDF-Hualngoram near Laitui village; CDF-Hualngoram said it may have been the Zomi National Army, which split from the junta-allied ZRA-EC.

incidents.title: Man found hanged in CDF-Thantlang custody
incidents.text: A 38-year-old man from Thinghual village, detained by CDF-Thantlang on a fraud accusation, was found hanged in custody.

incidents.title: CDF-Hualngoram fights ZRA-EC near Laitui
incidents.text: Fighting near Laitui village between CDF-Hualngoram and the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command), which has been attacking Chin forces.

incidents.title: Junta advances from Hakha to Thantlang
incidents.text: From 4 June about 200 junta troops advanced from Hakha along the Hakha-Thantlang road with heavy ground and air attacks; after five days Chin joint forces withdrew from some of their positions.

incidents.title: Heroin and tablets seized near Vaphai
incidents.text: Police near Vaphai arrested a local man and a 41-year-old Myanmar national with 618 grams of heroin and 4.749 kg of stimulant tablets.

incidents.detail: Bridge on the India-Myanmar trade road to Manipur
incidents.title: Bridge on Manipur trade road damaged
incidents.text: An unknown armed group damaged a bridge on the India-Myanmar trade road to Manipur in Tedim Township with mines, according to local people.

incidents.title: 23 kg stimulant tablets seized at Khankawn
incidents.text: Police at Khankawn checkpoint arrested three men, two from Kalay and one from Khawmawi village in Falam Township, with 23.355 kg of stimulant tablets.

incidents.title: Junta police seize 9.9 kg heroin at Kalay
incidents.text: Junta-backed police at a Kalay checkpoint seized 9.9 kg of heroin, 1.05 million stimulant tablets and 200 rounds being taken from Tedim towards Mandalay, with three vehicles; the carriers escaped.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Mindat four times
incidents.text: The junta bombed Mindat town four times with four bombs, damaging at least 10 homes. Counted as four attacks.

incidents.title: Daily fighting in Thantlang town
incidents.text: Daily fighting in Thantlang town from 10 to 15 June between the junta and Chin joint forces; five junta soldiers were killed and some injured, according to CDF-Thantlang.

incidents.title: Eight aircraft drop 62 bombs on CDF-Zophei headquarters
incidents.text: Eight junta aircraft dropped 62 bombs, eleven of them 500-pound bombs, on the CDF-Zophei headquarters in the Zopheiram area; a woman official of the Zopheiram Council's health and interior departments was killed and three people injured.

incidents.title: Landmine takes returnee's leg in Sumhrang
incidents.text: A 57-year-old man from Sumhrang village, returning home from displacement, lost a leg to a landmine laid near the village during the junta's temporary camp there.

incidents.detail: Nga Lai village, near his home (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: Landmine kills Nga Lai elder
incidents.text: A respected village elder of Nga Lai village was killed by a landmine near his home.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages six homes in Mindat Township
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on a village in Circle 13, Mindat Township, damaged six homes.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC kills Thuzang man
incidents.text: Accusing him over the death of one of its members, the junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) killed a young man from Thuzang village without trial.

incidents.title: Three arrested with drugs in Mizoram
incidents.text: The Excise and Narcotics Department arrested two local men and a 33-year-old man from Haiheng village, Falam Township, with 20 boxes of heroin in Aizawl.

incidents.title: Airstrikes on CDF-Hakha camps kill fighters
incidents.text: Junta airstrikes on two CDF-Hakha camps killed some fighters.

incidents.title: Airstrike burns two homes in Mindat
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Mindat town burned down two homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Kyin Dway camp kills five
incidents.text: With no fighting nearby, a junta airstrike on a displacement camp in Kyin Dway town killed five civilians, including two women, and injured more than ten.

incidents.detail: Farm hut near Kyauk Taung village
incidents.title: Drone bomb kills mother and child near Kyauk Taung
incidents.text: A junta drone bomb hit displaced people sheltering in a farm hut near Kyauk Taung village, killing a two-year-old child and her mother and injuring three. The briefing prints the date as 21 July.

incidents.title: Airstrike damages homes in Malsawm
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Malsawm village damaged at least two homes.

incidents.title: Airstrike on Sheim kills three children
incidents.text: A junta airstrike on Sheim village, Circle 4, killed three children of about ten years old and injured others.

incidents.title: ZRA-EC kills displaced man in Phaitu
incidents.text: The ZRA (Eastern Command) seized a displaced civilian from Gelmual village staying in Phaitu village and killed him, according to local people.

events.title: Chin National University opens English diploma
events.text: Chin National University said it would accept a second batch for its English diploma course starting in July.

actors: Chinland Govt: Ministry of Home Affairs
events.title: Chinland police refresher course
events.text: The Chinland Home Ministry held an 18-day refresher course in Chinlung for Chinland People's Police on crime prevention, investigation and legal work.

events.title: 17,000 displaced in Mindat Township
events.text: With fighting renewed by the junta's offensive to retake Mindat, about 17,000 people were displaced in Mindat Township and needed aid, according to the township IDP committee.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram CM raises refugee concern at NEC
events.text: At the 73rd North Eastern Council meeting in Shillong, Mizoram's Chief Minister said the steady arrival of refugees from Myanmar was a burden on the state.

events.title: CPU/CPA: 2,000 junta troops attack Mindat and Kanpetlet
events.text: CPU/CPA said that since mid-May about 2,000 junta troops had been on an offensive in Mindat and Kanpetlet Townships, with heavy fighting continuing; it said it was holding them back with allies and asked people not to believe junta claims.

events.title: CDF-Thantlang graduates 12th training batch
events.text: CDF-Thantlang held the graduation of its 12th basic military training batch at its headquarters.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: 67 Khumi flee AA conscription
events.text: Because the Arakan Army was conscripting one person from every Chin (Khumi) household, 67 people from villages including Shinmatang and Kuu fled to Bangladesh on 4 June; Bangladesh border guards pushed them back on 7 June.

events.title: Mindat displaced need food
events.text: The Mindat Township People's Administration said people displaced by the junta's offensive to retake Mindat urgently need food and other help.

events.title: India's ED traces drug money in Mizoram
events.text: India's Enforcement Directorate in Aizawl said money linked to cross-border drug trafficking and hawala found from 2025 to 8 June 2026 exceeded 152 crore rupees.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Delhi sends 5 crore rupees for Mizoram refugees
events.text: India's central government was arranging 5 crore rupees through Mizoram for refugees from Myanmar; there were more than 29,702 such refugees in the state.

events.title: Chinland meets Magway federal unit
events.text: The Chinland Government and the interim Magway federal unit government met on Zoom and discussed future cooperation.

events.title: Zophei bans overloaded vehicles
events.text: The Zophei Federal Council banned overloaded vehicles on roads in the Zophei area during the rainy season, so as not to damage them.

events.title: Myanmar nationals with Indian papers arrested
events.text: Since Min Aung Hlaing's visit to India, Myanmar nationals in Mizoram and New Delhi using Indian documents were being arrested and checked, and some were losing their documents.

events.title: Chinland Government marks Suu Kyi's birthday
events.text: On Daw Aung San Suu Kyi's 81st birthday the Chinland Government said it would work with the people and allies to end military rule and build a federal union.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Former Hakha council chair jailed 10 years
events.text: After an investigation, a court sentenced the former second chairman of the CDF-Hakha Central Council to 10 years with hard labour over the May killing of its former vice secretary.

events.title: Zopheiram-Hakha road closed to large vehicles
events.text: While damaged sections of the road between Zopheiram and Hakha are repaired, the Zopheiram council closed it to large vehicles from June for three months.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: YMA orders eight refugees out of Champhai
events.text: The YMA ordered eight refugees from Myanmar living in Bethel ward, Champhai, to leave the state, citing crimes against local people.

events.title: Diarrhoea in Mindat Circle 1 villages
events.text: Diarrhoea and dysentery broke out in villages of Circle 1, Mindat Township, from mid-June, and health help was needed.

events.title: AA says junta uses human shields in Mindat
events.text: The ULA/AA said the junta was using human shields in its offensive in Mindat and Kanpetlet, which CPU/CPA, the AA and Magway forces were fighting together.

incidents.detail: Eastern edge and areas near the town, 1-21 July
incidents.title: 51 air attacks on Kanpetlet in July
incidents.text: From 1 to 21 July the junta carried out at least 51 air attacks with at least 114 bombs on fighting areas on the eastern edge of Kanpetlet town. Recorded as 51 attacks on mixed targets.

incidents.detail: Near the town and its eastern edge, 1-21 July
incidents.title: 112 air attacks on Mindat in July
incidents.text: From 1 to 21 July the junta carried out at least 112 air attacks with at least 366 bombs near Mindat town and on its eastern edge, where fighting continues towards Kan Gyi village in Magway. Recorded as 112 attacks on mixed targets.

incidents.title: Junta drone bombs cause eye irritation in Thantlang
incidents.text: In the fighting in Thantlang, junta drone bombs dropped on Chin joint forces caused dizziness and eye irritation, and the CNF spokesperson said the bombs contained some kind of chemical. Recorded as one drone attack; the number of attacks was not given.

incidents.title: ZRA raids Tonzang villages
incidents.text: Residents said the junta-allied ZRA was entering villages in Tonzang Township, shooting and eating livestock, damaging homes and seizing Starlink equipment.

incidents.title: Junta bombs Mindat twice
incidents.text: On 6 and 7 July the junta bombed civilian areas of Mindat town twice with at least four bombs; damage details were not available. Counted as two attacks.

incidents.title: 700,000 tablets seized in Kalay
incidents.text: The junta's anti-drug police arrested six people, including three women, in Kalay with 700,000 stimulant tablets.

incidents.actors: Junta air force (jet fighters and Y-12)
incidents.title: 76 bombs on CDF-Hakha camp near Lunghnam
incidents.text: At about noon junta jets and Y-12 aircraft dropped 76 bombs, including 500-pound bombs, on a CDF-Hakha camp near Lunghnam village, destroying some buildings.

incidents.title: Jet attack on Mindat village kills woman
incidents.text: In a junta jet fighter attack, two bombs were dropped on a village in Mindat Township, killing a 40-year-old woman, injuring others and damaging more than 10 homes.

incidents.title: Falam man arrested with heroin in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: Police in Zokhawthar arrested a 52-year-old man from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 48 grams of heroin.

incidents.title: Falam man arrested with drugs in Champhai
incidents.text: Police checking a passenger vehicle at a Champhai checkpoint arrested a 20-year-old man from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 26 grams of heroin.

incidents.detail: Junta checkpoint at mile 16, Falam-Hakha road
incidents.title: Junta soldiers beat two brothers at checkpoint
incidents.text: Junta soldiers at the mile 16 checkpoint on the Falam-Hakha road beat two brothers returning to Hrianghnang village to collect belongings; the 27-year-old elder brother died and the younger was badly injured.

incidents.detail: Towards southern Chinland from Pakokku and Meiktila
incidents.title: 1,000 junta troops head to southern Chinland
incidents.text: About 400 troops of LID 24 from Pakokku and about 600 of LID 99 from Meiktila, some 1,000 in all, were reported heading to southern Chinland to reinforce the junta in Mindat and Kanpetlet.

incidents.detail: Near the Catholic church, Vankau ward
incidents.title: Missing education officer found dead in Hakha
incidents.text: A district education officer from Cinmual ward, missing for about ten days, was found dead near the Catholic church in Vankau ward, where junta troops are based; residents believe junta troops killed him.

incidents.title: Junta arrests CDM police officer
incidents.text: Junta troops arrested a former police officer who had joined the Civil Disobedience Movement, from Sunthla village, as he went to fetch farm supplies in Tlanglo ward, Falam.

incidents.title: Junta claims Thantlang, CDF-Thantlang denies
incidents.text: The junta said on 16 July that it had taken full control of Thantlang town; the CDF-Thantlang spokesperson called this propaganda and said daily fighting continued.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha kills police battalion commander
incidents.text: CDF-Hakha shot dead a police battalion commander and his bodyguard as they rode a motorbike in Ward 19, Hakha.

incidents.detail: Near a party office and a children's hospital
incidents.title: Jet bombs near children's hospital in Mindat
incidents.text: A junta jet from the Tada-U air base dropped four 500-pound bombs near a party office and a children's hospital in Mindat town, damaging buildings.

incidents.title: Two arrested with drugs in Niawhtlang
incidents.text: The Excise and Narcotics Department in Niawhtlang village arrested a 40-year-old man from Resaw (Zesaw) village in the Mara area and a local man with 6.87 kg of opium believed to come from Mindat Township.

incidents.actors: Mizoram Police and Young Mizo Association
incidents.title: Matupi man arrested with heroin in Thingsai
incidents.text: Mizoram Police and the YMA at Thingsai arrested a 42-year-old man from Leising village, Matupi Township, with 50.39 grams of heroin.

incidents.detail: Between Tedim town and Kennedy Peak
incidents.title: PDF-Zoland ambushes junta and ZRA column
incidents.text: PDF-Zoland ambushed a junta and ZRA (Eastern Command) column between Tedim town and Kennedy Peak; six were killed, three of them ZRA-EC, and many injured.

incidents.title: 1.56 million tablets seized near Kalay
incidents.text: The junta arrested four people from Mandalay and Kalay smuggling 1.56 million stimulant tablets to Kalay.

incidents.actors: Mizoram Excise and Narcotics and Assam Rifles
incidents.title: 601 g heroin seized at Siasi
incidents.text: The Excise and Narcotics Department and Assam Rifles arrested two Myanmar nationals at Siasi checkpoint with 601 grams of heroin.

events.others: Zoland National University (NUZ); Myanmar Spring University (MNOU)
events.title: Zoland National University signs education deal
events.text: Zoland National University and Myanmar Spring University signed an online agreement to cooperate in seven areas of education, including exchange of teachers, researchers and course materials.

events.title: CPU/CPA reports heavy junta losses
events.text: CPU/CPA said that in the fighting in Mindat and Kanpetlet since mid-May, junta forces had suffered heavy losses and that it had captured soldiers, weapons and supplies. On 31 July it said junta casualties in July included battalion commanders and majors.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Vaphai YMA sets 12 rules for refugees
events.text: The Vaphai Young Mizo Association issued 12 rules for refugees from Myanmar in the village, including no separate fellowship meetings, Sunday rules, using mainly the Mizo language and following traffic and environmental rules.

events.title: Zotung clears landslides
events.text: The Zotung Federal Council said it was clearing landslides on roads in the Zotung area, including the Gangaw-Aika-Rezua road, blocked by heavy rain.

events.title: CDF-Hakha warns of plainclothes soldiers
events.text: Because junta soldiers and non-CDM staff were moving around Hakha in civilian clothes, CDF-Hakha warned people not to move around between 7 PM and 6 AM from 7 July and to report suspicious people.

events.detail: Villages in northern Paletwa, near the Bangladesh border
events.title: Floods hit northern Paletwa
events.text: Heavy rain from 7 July flooded villages in northern Paletwa Township, damaging homes, schools and farms; flood victims near the Bangladesh border needed medicine, food and shelter.

events.detail: Roads to Hakha and to India
events.title: Landslides on Thantlang-Hakha roads
events.text: Heavy rain caused landslides on roads and village tracks from Thantlang to Hakha and to India, and residents worried about rising prices.

events.title: 1,700 displaced from Tonzang need medicine
events.text: More than 1,700 people from Tonzang town and 20 villages had been displaced to forests and nearby townships since May, and needed medicine, food and blankets.

events.title: Mizoram seizes drugs worth 434 crore rupees
events.text: Mizoram Police said that from January to June 2026 it seized drugs worth 434.66 crore rupees, including 235.902 kg of stimulant tablets and 25.913 kg of heroin, and arrested 212 people, 57 of them foreigners, mostly from Myanmar.

events.title: Computer and Chin language courses open
events.text: The Chinland Council Chairman and the Chinland Education Minister attended the opening of computer and Chin language courses run by the Chinlung Learning Initiative.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Food short in Kanpetlet under blockade
events.text: With fighting in Kanpetlet Township and the junta's blockade, food was running short and people were facing hardship.

events.title: Chinland: 180 air attacks in June
events.text: The Chinland Government's human rights ministry said that in June the junta carried out more than 180 air attacks in Chinland, killing nine civilians including three women and injuring 17, and a junta landmine took a civilian's leg.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.others: Asho (Chin) National Federal Council (ACNFC); Rimawdaing forces
events.title: Asho Chin National Defence Army formed
events.text: The Rimawdaing forces renamed themselves the Asho (Chin) National Defence Army and will operate as a regular force under the political leadership of the Asho (Chin) National Federal Council.

events.title: SCEF meets People Movement Platform
events.text: SCEF, which includes the CNF, met online with groups in the People Movement Platform and CDM representatives, explained its work and discussed cooperation.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Khumi party rejects Paletwa as part of Rakhine
events.text: The Khumi National Unity Party said it would not accept media reports that place Paletwa inside Rakhine State, and asked them to write 'Paletwa (district), Chin State'.

events.others: SCEF (CNF, KNU, KIO, Karenni); ASEAN chair's special envoy; Thai Foreign Minister
events.title: SCEF meets ASEAN envoy
events.text: SCEF members including the CNF, KNU and KIO met the ASEAN chair's special envoy on Myanmar, the Philippine Foreign Secretary, and the Thai Foreign Minister in Thailand. SCEF set out six positions, including that the junta's administration is not legitimate and that the ASEAN five-point consensus must be implemented.

events.others: ULA Humanitarian and Development Coordination Office (HDCO)
issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Maraland council gives flood aid via ULA
events.text: The Maraland Territorial Council gave 5 million kyats to the ULA's humanitarian office for flood relief in Arakan, including Paletwa.

events.title: Third nursing diploma intake
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Health invited applications for 40 places in the third batch of its Diploma in Nursing and Midwifery, closing in early September.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: CDF-Mara graduates 100 recruits
events.text: CDF-Mara held the graduation of its sixth basic training batch, with more than 100 new recruits.

events.title: CNF marks Martyrs' Day
events.text: On the 79th Martyrs' Day held by the CRPH and NUG, the CNF paid tribute to General Aung San and the other martyrs and to those who died fighting military rule.

events.title: CDF-Paletwa disowns online account
events.text: CDF-Paletwa said an online account spreading claims harmful to its reputation was not one of its members, and ordered people in its area not to share or follow that account's posts from 20 July.

events.title: CDF-Matupi repairs road
events.text: The Vakok battalion of CDF-Matupi (Chinland Government forces) said it was urgently repairing landslide-damaged sections of the Matupi-Hakha road.

events.title: Lawyers urge Philippines to act on Chin case
events.text: International lawyers again urged the Philippine Justice Ministry to act on the 2023 complaint by Chin people against Myanmar generals over war crimes.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Delhi refugees told to avoid protests
events.text: With tensions over the 2026 NEET-UG exam paper leak, the Chin Refugee Committee in New Delhi warned refugees not to take part in protests or gatherings.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chinland Council adopts five plans
events.text: The second meeting of the Chinland Council's second term, 23-25 July in Chinlung, adopted five future plans on defence, political assessment, strengthening Chinland Government forces and Chin unity, and urged revolutionary forces to avoid steps that legitimise the junta.

events.title: CDF-Zotung graduates special force
events.text: CDF-Zotung held the graduation of its fifth special force training batch.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Mizoram CM tried to unite Chin groups
events.text: At the Joint Hnampual Meet 2026 in Aizawl, Mizoram's Chief Minister said he had tried to help Chin resistance groups unite under one administration, drafting founding rules and arranging a signing, but this had not yet succeeded.

events.title: Fever and diarrhoea in 16 Daai villages
events.text: Since mid-July, fever and diarrhoea spread in 16 villages of the Daai area, Paletwa Township, for lack of medicine; one child died on 27 July.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Min Aung Hlaing names CNO among non-NCA groups
events.text: In a speech marking his first 100 days, Min Aung Hlaing said 12 groups that have not signed the NCA, including the Chin National Organization based in Falam Township, had met the junta for peace talks.

incidents.title: Stray bullet kills woman in Hakha
incidents.text: During a clash between junta soldiers and police at a camp near Shukhinthar in Hakha, a stray bullet killed a 51-year-old woman living nearby.

incidents.title: Jets bomb Thanshwe, monk injured
incidents.text: At about 10 PM two junta jets dropped four bombs on Thanshwe village, injuring a 28-year-old Buddhist monk and damaging a monastery, a school and homes.

incidents.title: Kalay man arrested with heroin at Khankawn
incidents.text: Police at Khankawn checkpoint arrested a 27-year-old man from Kalay with 118 grams of heroin.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
incidents.title: AA arrests four Paletwa men
incidents.text: Four Chin men from Paletwa Township, including village leaders, arrested by the Arakan Army in July while working on wood and charcoal, had still not been able to contact their families.

incidents.title: Jet bombs Khawhtu village
incidents.text: A junta jet dropped two 500-pound bombs on Khawhtu village, damaging buildings; some civilians were slightly injured.

incidents.title: Two Falam men arrested with heroin
incidents.text: Police near Zokhawthar arrested two men from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 65 grams of heroin.

incidents.detail: Near a shop at the town entrance
incidents.title: Jet bombs Paletwa town entrance, two students hurt
incidents.text: At about 7 AM a junta jet dropped a bomb near a shop at the entrance of Paletwa town, injuring two Chin students aged 13 and 19.

incidents.detail: By helicopter from Kalay to Tonzang and Hakha, 12-13 August
incidents.title: Junta flies 300 troops to Tonzang and Hakha
incidents.text: The junta flew about 200 troops from Kalay to Tonzang in seven helicopter trips and about 100 to Hakha in three trips, according to military and local sources.

incidents.detail: Town entrance and former junta camp
incidents.title: Jet bombs Samee, girl killed
incidents.text: At about 11 PM a junta jet dropped four bombs on the entrance of Samee town and a former junta camp, killing a 16-year-old girl and injuring seven, including small children.

incidents.detail: Near a former police camp where junta troops were based
incidents.title: Drone bombs on Tibual
incidents.text: The junta dropped drone bombs three times on Tibual village, targeting a site near the police camp where junta troops had been based; no civilian harm was reported.

incidents.detail: Near Varr bridge, where junta troops were based during the Falam offensive
incidents.title: Landmine injures power workers near Varr bridge
incidents.text: Two electricity department staff going to repair a power line near Varr bridge, Falam, stepped on a landmine; an 18-year-old lost a leg and hand and a 24-year-old was badly injured.

incidents.title: Drone bombs Kanpetlet displacement camp
incidents.text: Junta drone bombs on a displacement camp in Kanpetlet Township badly injured a 25-year-old woman and destroyed two shelters, according to the township humanitarian and disaster department.

incidents.title: Mother and son arrested with 620,000 tablets
incidents.text: A junta-backed joint force arrested a mother and son in Sanmyo ward, Kalay, with 620,000 stimulant tablets bought from three people in Kalay, Yangon and Tedim, according to the junta's CCDAC.

incidents.detail: On the Paletwa-Kyauktaw road, held by the Arakan Army
incidents.title: Jets bomb Sein Nyin Wa, five killed
incidents.text: Two junta jets dropped two 500-pound bombs, a 200-pound bomb and eight rockets on Sein Nyin Wa village, killing two young men and three women and injuring 17 including eight children, and damaging 19 homes, a monastery and a clinic.

incidents.detail: Near Chindwin bridge and a Kalay ward
incidents.title: 118,000 tablets seized near Kalay
incidents.text: Junta anti-drug police and a joint force seized 118,000 stimulant tablets near Kalay and arrested four people from Kalay; one more escaped.

incidents.detail: ZNA camp between Tikyang Lui and Muallum villages
incidents.title: ZRA-EC takes Zomi National Army camp
incidents.text: The junta-allied ZRA (Eastern Command) attacked and took a camp of the Zomi National Army, which split from it, between Tikyang Lui and Muallum villages; the ZNA had injuries and lost a drone and two small arms.

incidents.detail: Maraland Defense Force camp near Shwe Laik Wa village, on the India border
incidents.title: Jet attack on Maraland Defense Force camp kills four
incidents.text: In a junta jet fighter attack, two bombs were dropped on a Maraland Defense Force camp near Shwe Laik Wa village on the India-Myanmar border, killing four fighters and injuring others.

incidents.title: Five jets drop over 50 bombs on Mee Zar, two killed
incidents.text: At about 9 AM five junta jets dropped more than 50 bombs on and around Mee Zar village, killing a father and son and injuring six, according to Paletwa Times.

incidents.title: Junta police screen travellers at Khaikam
incidents.text: At the mile 9 police checkpoint near Khaikam, junta police were screening travellers from Chinland with the People Surveillance Management System and arresting CDM staff and people with political records, residents said.

incidents.title: Falam woman arrested with heroin in Champhai
incidents.text: Police in Zotlang ward, Champhai, arrested a 27-year-old woman from Khawmawi village, Falam Township, with 253.30 grams of heroin.

incidents.detail: ZRA-EC camp at Natphi village (not matched in MIMU)
incidents.title: CDF-Tonzang takes ZRA-EC camp at Natphi
incidents.text: CDF-Tonzang (Chinland Council) attacked and took a ZRA (Eastern Command) camp at Natphi village, seizing ammunition and supplies.

incidents.title: Jets bomb Wumkhum, eight killed
incidents.text: Two junta jets bombed Wumkhum village, killing eight civilians including two students and four women, injuring 15 and burning 10 homes, according to the Chin People's Union.

events.type: Meeting or agreement between border authorities
events.others: ICFAI University, Mizoram; Chin National University
events.title: ICFAI and Chin National University sign agreement
events.text: ICFAI University in Mizoram and Chin National University signed a memorandum of agreement on study for students from Chinland, curriculum development and cooperation between the two universities.

issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: CNO disowns leaders' talks with junta
events.text: The Chin National Organization said its leaders' July meeting in New Delhi with the junta's NPSNC did not represent the organisation and was not a decision or agreement; after an inquiry it removed its chairman from his post.

events.others: Chin Peace Reconciliation Initiative (CPRI); Advocacy Group for Peace Mizoram
issues: Chin unity, disputes and the CNC talks
events.title: Chin Peace Summit in Aizawl
events.text: At the Chin Peace Summit 2026 in Aizawl, 6-8 August, led by CPRI and the Advocacy Group for Peace Mizoram, CPRI met the Chinland Council and the ICNCC separately. They discussed humanitarian cooperation, ending attacks and propaganda against each other, and future Chin unity through a Chin National Council (CNC).

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.others: SCEF; Joint committee on war and post-war policy
events.title: SCEF elects co-chairs
events.text: SCEF, which includes the CNF, and its policy group held an online joint meeting that elected two co-chairs, a secretary and two joint secretaries of a joint committee on strategy and post-war policy.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Thantlang bans unlicensed weapons
events.text: The Thantlang Peng Council banned keeping, selling or transporting unlicensed weapons and military supplies in CDF-Thantlang areas, under the Chinland Council arms law and the CDF-Thantlang Control Act.

events.title: CDF-Hakha warns of gang using its name
events.text: CDF-Hakha said a gang was using the names of the CNA and CDF-Hakha to threaten homes in Hakha with weapons and extort money, and warned it would arrest them.

events.title: CNF marks Kachin Revolution Day
events.text: In a message on Kachin Revolution Day the CNF said it would keep working with the KIO for a federal democratic union.

events.title: Prices soar in Mindat
events.text: Because of the junta offensive, road blocks, heavy rain and landslides, prices in Mindat Township rose sharply: a bag of rice from 120,000 to over 200,000 kyats, a litre of cooking oil from 8,000 to 15,000 kyats and salt from 15,000 to 25,000 kyats a viss.

events.title: Only 20% back in Falam
events.text: More than three months after the junta retook Falam, only about 20 percent of residents had returned because of safety concerns, according to local humanitarian workers.

events.title: 1,000 Kanpetlet displaced in forests
events.text: More than 1,000 people from villages in Kanpetlet Township, displaced by junta ground and air attacks, were sheltering in forests and needed food and medicine.

events.title: CDF-KKG member and others murdered
events.text: CDF-KKG said a central committee member, a fighter and a displaced civilian were murdered near a village in Gangaw Township, and said it would act against those responsible and those who helped them.

events.type: Alliance, merger or new body formed
events.others: SCEF; Mandalay Region and Sagaing federal unit
events.title: SCEF adds Mandalay and Sagaing members
events.text: SCEF, which includes the CNF, agreed to accept the Mandalay Region and the Sagaing federal unit as members.

events.title: Displaced girl dies of snakebite
events.text: A 15-year-old girl from Mindat, displaced to Chin Let Mun village in Kanpetlet Township, died of a snakebite because security risks prevented her reaching treatment.

events.title: Third community development diploma batch
events.text: Chin National University announced a third batch of its Diploma in Community Development starting in September, open to those with basic education completion from the Chinland or NUG education ministries and others.

events.others: Khumi National Congress Party/Khumi People Front (KNCP/KPF)
events.title: Khumi man arrested with bullets in Lawngtlai
events.text: Police and local groups searching a house in Lawngtlai where Myanmar nationals lived arrested a Khumi man and seized 73 bullets, military supplies, 2 million kyats and 500,000 rupees; media said it was a temporary office of the KNCP/KPF from Paletwa.

events.title: CNF mourns CDF-Asho commander
events.text: The CNF sent condolences on the death of the CDF-Asho commander and fighters, calling it an irreplaceable loss for the Chin revolution.

events.title: Man arrested with three AK-47s
events.text: Assam Rifles and police near New Ngharchhip village arrested a man from Lunglei District bringing three AK-47 rifles and ammunition illegally from Leising village, Matupi Township.

issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Lay Hsin villagers protest CPA recruitment
events.text: Residents of Lay Hsin village in CDF-Matupi's Region 3 protested against the Chin People's Army recruiting there and setting up a checkpoint.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Mizoram has 31,375 people from Myanmar
events.text: Mizoram's Home Minister told the state assembly there are 31,375 people from Myanmar in Mizoram, 28,312 of them refugees, and that more than 25.8 crore rupees had been spent to support them.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: YMA expels six Kalay men from Champhai
events.text: The YMA in New Champhai ward expelled six men from Kalay living there as refugees, saying they were involved in drug trading.

events.title: Chinland Council launches two-year report
events.text: The Chinland Council held two online launches of its report on two years of self-determined administration, with 32 representatives of embassies and international organisations and 13 media outlets, on 24 and 28 August.

events.title: Junta kills pastor, says BRI
events.text: The Burma Research Institute said junta troops of LIB 77 led by a colonel arrested and killed a pastor of the Assemblies of God church and another man from Chuncung village in June, and asked the United States and international bodies to hold them to account.

events.title: Chinland Defence Ministry hires directors
events.text: The Chinland Ministry of Defence invited applications for two vacant posts, a director and a deputy director, with a September deadline.

issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Junta checkpoints raise fares
events.text: After the junta retook the Kalay-Tedim and Kalay-Falam-Hakha roads, it set up many checkpoints and extorted money, so fares rose to as much as 150,000 kyats from Kalay to Tedim and 200,000 kyats from Kalay to Falam.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Senthang warns junta informants
events.text: The Sengthang Central Council said the junta was gathering intelligence in its area through non-CDM staff and others, and that anyone taking part would face action under its laws.

issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Lawngtlai restricts refugees
events.text: Officials and civil society in Lawngtlai District, meeting under the District Commissioner, decided that no foreigners or refugees may rent houses in the district.

incidents.title: Falam man arrested with 14 kg meth near Tuichang
incidents.text: A 29-year-old man from Falam Township arrested with more than 14 kg of methamphetamine tablets worth around INR 11.408 crore.

incidents.detail: Entrance road to Tedim town (Falam-Thaingngin road)
incidents.title: PDF-Zoland mines junta convoy
incidents.text: PDF-Zoland announced a mine attack on a junta convoy returning to Tedim-based Infantry Battalion 269 via the Falam-Thaingngin road after duty on the Thantlang front. Casualties not disclosed.

incidents.actors: Junta (120mm, fired from Saw Township, Magway)
incidents.title: Shelling from Saw kills elderly couple near Mindat
incidents.text: Indiscriminate 120mm heavy weapons fire from the Saw Township border area, Magway Region, killed a local couple, both aged around 60.

incidents.title: Myanmar man arrested with heroin in Zokhawthar
incidents.text: One male Myanmar national arrested with 115 grams of heroin.

incidents.title: 12.7 kg meth seized near Keifang, Mizoram
incidents.text: 12.746 kg of methamphetamine tablets worth more than INR 10 crore seized from a scooter travelling from Champhai to Aizawl. Two men arrested, one a Myanmar national (counted here) and one a local man.

incidents.title: Meth and heroin seized at Khankawn checkpoint
incidents.text: 994 g of methamphetamine tablets (over INR 79 lakh) seized from a man from Kalay, and 141 g of heroin (about INR 28 lakh) from two men from Falam Township.

incidents.actors: Area where ZRA-EC moves; clash with CDF-Hualngoram in June
incidents.title: Landmine kills two in Laitui
incidents.text: Two local residents were killed and three seriously injured when a landmine was stepped on and exploded.

incidents.title: Zomi National Army attacks ZRA-EC outpost at Zampi
incidents.text: The Zomi National Army attacked an outpost of the junta-aligned Zomi Revolutionary Army (Eastern Command). One ZRA-EC member was killed and two were seriously injured.

incidents.detail: Near Social Welfare Office, Bawithat ward
incidents.title: Two bombs near Social Welfare Office in Mindat
incidents.text: Two bombs dropped near the Social Welfare Office. Damage details not released.

incidents.title: 290,000 meth tablets seized in Kalay
incidents.text: 290,000 methamphetamine tablets (MMK 725 million) seized from a vehicle; the 30-year-old driver and a second man aged 23 arrested.

incidents.title: Bomb damages shop and car in Bweli
incidents.text: A 300-pound bomb damaged a general store, a car and a Starlink device and killed some livestock. No civilian injuries reported.

incidents.title: 80 prisoners escape PDF-Zoland detention
incidents.text: More than 80 prisoners of war, including a junta major, held by PDF-Zoland seized weapons from their guards and escaped.

incidents.actors: PDF-Zoland vs escaped prisoners of war
incidents.title: Pastor killed in crossfire near Kaptel
incidents.text: During an exchange of fire while PDF-Zoland pursued the escaped prisoners, a Baptist pastor returning to his home village of Lamzang was hit by a bullet and killed; his older brother was injured.

incidents.title: Kalay woman arrested with 760,000 tablets
incidents.text: A 37-year-old woman arrested at her home with 760,000 methamphetamine tablets (MMK 1.9 billion).

incidents.title: Jets bomb school and homes in Maw Chaung
incidents.text: Bombed twice by jet fighters although there was no ground fighting. A school and some civilian homes were damaged.

incidents.actors: Mizoram Excise and Narcotics, Assam Rifles, Special Branch
incidents.title: Bukphir man arrested with 5.5 kg meth
incidents.text: A 20-year-old man from Bukphir village, Chinland, arrested with 5.5 kg of methamphetamine tablets.

incidents.title: Six bombs damage school and homes in Phongpin
incidents.text: Six bombs dropped, injuring one male civilian and damaging a school, staff housing and four homes.

incidents.title: CDF-Hakha attacks junta police in Hakha
incidents.text: Chinland Defense Force-Hakha attacked junta police personnel at a road junction in the Old Town ward. Casualty details not released.

incidents.title: Six jets bomb church and pastor's house in Masa Tui
incidents.text: Bombed by six jet fighters, injuring one male civilian and damaging a church and a pastor's house.

incidents.detail: Advance from Laungshe (Magway) towards Masa Tui village
incidents.title: 500 junta troops advance on Masa Tui
incidents.text: According to military sources, a junta column of around 500 troops from Light Infantry Divisions 77, 55, 99 and 88 is advancing via Laungshe town, Magway Region, towards Masa Tui village.

figures.indicator: Airstrikes as printed in the briefing
figures.note: Printed figure counted bombs (six at Phongpin). Counted by attack: 4

figures.indicator: Airstrikes as printed in the briefing
figures.note: Printed figure counted two bombs in one attack. Counted by attack: 1

figures.indicator: Airstrikes as printed in the briefing

figures.note: One church and one clergy residence
Published rounded; incidents add up to 6.494

figures.indicator: Children killed by airstrikes in Chinland, year to date

events.detail: Six locations: Mindat and Matupi Townships; Champhai, Lunglei, Aizawl and Mamit in Mizoram (1 to 21 September)
events.title: Food aid to displaced at six sites
events.text: NCCD provided basic food assistance to Chin displaced people at six locations, two in Mindat and Matupi Townships and others in Champhai, Lunglei, Aizawl and Mamit in Mizoram.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Lautu bans poison and explosive fishing
events.text: The Lautu Area People's Administration Body banned fishing by poisoning, explosives and other harmful methods during the spawning season. Violations carry a fine of MMK 100,000 to 5,000,000 plus action under existing laws.

events.detail: Gangaw-Rezua and Matupi-Rezua-Hakha roads (Zotung area), 2 to 7 September
events.title: Zotung reopens roads after landslides
events.text: The Zotung Federal Council cleared landslides on the Gangaw-Rezua and Matupi-Rezua-Hakha road sections with machinery, reopening them to travellers and vehicles.

events.title: Chinland brings forces under one command
events.text: The Chinland Government is continuing the force-formation process so that the Chin National Army and all Chinland Defense Forces come under a single chain of command under civilian supervision and control.

events.title: Flood destroys church
events.text: Four consecutive days of rain caused the Kwe stream to flood and erode its banks, washing away and destroying the Maranatha AG church and one house in Khaikam town.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chinland prepares military service law
events.text: The Speaker of the Chinland Parliament said the Parliament, the Ministry of Defence and the Defence Coordination Team are jointly preparing a Chinland Defence Law as a priority. Terms of Reference on basic operating procedures for defence forces have been sent to the relevant organizations.

events.title: Senthang bans unlicensed weapons
events.text: The Senthang Central Council prohibited carrying weapons, ammunition or military equipment without a valid licence or recommendation from the relevant revolutionary armed group. Any military equipment found must be handed over to the authority.

events.title: CDF-Mara bans carrying arms without permission
events.text: CDF-Mara warned that no one may carry arms or move around armed in areas under its control without official permission, citing junta airstrikes and informants.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: Khumi group objects to AA Rakhine curriculum
events.text: The Global Khumi Organization objected to ULA/AA imposing a Rakhine-language basic education curriculum in Paletwa Township without local consent, calling it a violation of UNDRIP.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Border fence, FMR and refugees in Mizoram
events.title: Lawngtlai curfew for refugees
events.text: The Lawngtlai District Administrator ordered refugees and foreigners to stay in after 8 pm except in emergencies, to obtain work permits from the Village Council and YLA, and banned renting houses to non-Indian citizens.

issues: Arakan Army rule in Paletwa
events.title: CNC-Matupi objects to Rakhine curriculum in Paletwa
events.text: CNC-Matupi objected to plans to replace the Myanmar-language curriculum in Paletwa schools with a Rakhine-language one without Chin consent, and said Paletwa administration should be run jointly by Chin and Rakhine.

events.title: CNF message on Democracy Day
events.text: The CNF sent a message to the International Day of Democracy ceremony held by the CRPH, urging continued struggle for a federal democratic union with national equality and self-determination.

events.type: Road or trade route closed or reopened
events.title: CDF-Hualngoram closes Tedim-Rihkhawdar road
events.text: CDF-Hualngoram temporarily closed the road connecting Tedim town and Rihkhawdar on the India-Myanmar border for public safety due to the military situation.

actors: Chinland Govt: Ministry of Home Affairs
issues: Military service and forced recruitment
events.title: Local government workshop
events.text: A three-day workshop on two-way engagement between local government and the public, led by GFN with the Ministry of Home Affairs, discussed public trust, financial transparency, overlapping taxes, education and youth fear of conscription, and adopted 14 working guidelines.

events.title: Mara closes trade routes after clash with Rakhine traders
events.text: After a clash between Rakhine traders and Mara youths in Khaikhy village in which an MTP camp was burned, the MTP closed trade routes to Paletwa Township. They reopened after the two sides met and negotiated.

events.type: Eviction or relocation of IDP site
events.title: 45 displaced households told to leave Seimawl camp
events.text: Local authorities ordered 45 displaced households from Matupi Township at Seimawl IDP Camp-2 to relocate within 7 days because the camp lies on the route of a planned highway. The households face relocation costs.

events.title: HPO repairs village roads
events.text: The Hualngoram Peoples Organization announced that village-to-village road sections damaged by landslides and stream erosion have been fully repaired.

events.title: Zopheiram opens diploma intake
events.text: The third intake of the Community Development Program diploma course of Zopheiram Pre-College, under the Zopheiram Government's Department of Education, opened.

events.type: Order or policy by border authority
issues: Cross-border trade routes
events.title: Lawngtlai tightens border trade checks
events.text: The Lawngtlai District Administrator said goods transport and border trade into Myanmar will be checked more strictly, including vehicles owned by non-Indian citizens, as the Kaladan route through Zorinpui grows in importance.

events.title: 800 Matupi displaced struggle at Thiak Rawl
events.text: Around 800 Chin displaced people from Matupi Township at Thiak Rawl IDP camp face financial difficulties buying shelter materials and basic food.

events.title: Maraland council approves military service law
events.text: The Maraland Territorial Council's third Central Council meeting approved 17 proposals, including a draft military service law, with the NUG Union Minister for Federal Affairs and the ICNCC/CB chairman attending.

issues: Laws, courts and police in Chinland
events.title: Chief Justice on court challenges
events.text: The Chief Justice said the judiciary faces challenges in coordination between the Supreme Court and township and regional courts, judge capacity and prison standards. Stronger links between courts and training for judicial staff are planned as priorities.

events.title: Chinland warns against junta schools
events.text: The Ministry of Education warned people in Chinland not to engage with junta schools and offices, saying the junta is pressing self-reliant schools to link with its schools to gain legitimacy.

events.title: Chinland Government marks NLD anniversary
events.text: On the NLD's 38th anniversary, the Chinland Government said it respects the NLD's political leadership role and will work with it towards ending dictatorship and building a federal union.
